original: 9. Abilities
translation: 能力

original: 9.1. General
translation: 总则

original: 9.1.1. An {term:ability} is an independent unit of text on a card or counter, a basic action, or the basic trash ability.
translation: 一项{term:能力}，是卡牌或指示物上的独立文本单元，或一个基础行动，或基础销毁能力。

original: 9.1.1.a. All rules text on a card or counter is part of an ability.
translation: 卡牌或指示物上的所有规则文本，都是某项能力的一部分。

original: 9.1.1.b. The basic actions are defined in {ref:rule_corp_actions} and {ref:rule_runner_actions}.
translation: 基础行动定义于{ref:rule_corp_actions}与{ref:rule_runner_actions}。

original: 9.1.1.c. The basic trash ability is defined in {ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}.
translation: 基础销毁能力定义于{ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}。

original: 9.1.1.d. An ability's text can include other abilities that it could grant to cards or counters or introduce directly to the game state. See also {ref:sec_lingering_effects}.
translation: 一项能力的文本，可以包含其可能赋予卡牌或指示物的其他能力，或直接引入游戏状态中的其他能力。另见{ref:sec_lingering_effects}。

original: 9.1.1.e. Each ability is categorized as either a static ability ({ref:sec_static_abilities}), a paid ability ({ref:sec_paid_abilities}), a conditional ability ({ref:sec_conditional_abilities}), a play ability ({ref:sec_play_abilities}), or a subroutine ({ref:sec_subroutines}).
translation: 每项能力都归类为持续能力（{ref:sec_static_abilities}）、付费能力（{ref:sec_paid_abilities}）、条件能力（{ref:sec_conditional_abilities}）、打出能力（{ref:sec_play_abilities}）或子进程（{ref:sec_subroutines}）之一。

original: 9.1.1.f. Abilities marked with [interrupt] or that include the word "would" in their instructions have special timing rules that differ from other abilities. See {ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}.
translation: 带有[interrupt]标记，或其指示中包含“would”一词的能力，具有不同于其他能力的特殊时机规则。见{ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}。

original: 9.1.1.g. Each non-static ability contains one or more {term:instructions} that make up the ability's component steps. {ref:Rule_instruction} describes the nature and function of instructions in an ability's text. An instruction that the game is presently concerned with can be either {term:imminent} or {term:resolving}.
translation: 每个非持续能力都包含一个或多个{term:指示}，构成该能力的组成步骤。{ref:Rule_instruction}描述了能力文本中指示的性质与功能。游戏当前正在处理的一项指示，可以处于{term:即将发生}或{term:正在结算}状态。

original: 9.1.2. To {term:resolve an ability} means to resolve each of that ability's instructions in the order they appear. If an ability contains more than one instruction, a checkpoint occurs between each consecutive instruction. To {term:resolve an instruction} means to carry out that instruction.
translation: {term:结算一项能力}，是指按其出现顺序逐一结算该能力的每项指示。如果一项能力包含多于一条指示，则每两条相邻指示之间都会发生一次检查点。{term:结算一项指示}，是指执行该项指示。

original: 9.1.2.a. While resolving an ability, other abilities can meet their conditions. When this happens, a "chain reaction" is created. The current instruction finishes resolving, then more recent abilities fully resolve before the next instruction of the original ability. If any other abilities meet their conditions while resolving the "chained" abilities, then another "chain" is created before continuing to resolve the previous chained abilities. Resolve each set of chained abilities one at a time, from the most recently met condition to the oldest, before continuing with the original ability that started the chain reaction.
translation: 在结算一项能力期间，其他能力可能满足其条件。当这种情况发生时，就会产生一次“连锁反应”。当前指示先完成结算，然后较新的能力会在原能力的下一条指示之前完全结算。如果在结算这些“连锁”的能力时，又有其他能力满足其条件，则在继续结算先前连锁能力之前，会再产生另一条“连锁”。每组连锁能力都要逐组结算，从最新满足条件的开始，依序到最早者，然后才继续结算引发这次连锁反应的原始能力。

original: The Runner's identity is {card:Armand "Geist" Walker}. They access a {card:Snare!} from R&D with only 2 cards in their grip. Before taking a tag or suffering any net damage, the Runner triggers {card:Decoy}'s ability in order to avoid the tag. Using the {card:Decoy} meets the trigger condition of {card:Armand "Geist" Walker}'s ability. As this is the most recent ability to meet its trigger condition, {card:Armand "Geist" Walker}'s ability must resolve first, before {card:Decoy} avoids the tag and before {card:Snare!} finishes resolving. The Runner draws a card from {card:Armand "Geist" Walker}, avoids the tag from {card:Snare!} with {card:Decoy}, and then finally suffers (and survives) the 3 net damage from {card:Snare!}.
translation: 潜袭者的特性是 {card:阿曼德·“游魂”·沃克}。其从研发中心读取到一张 {card:圈套！}，且其操控器中只有 2 张卡牌。在拿取锁定标记或受到任何网域伤害之前，潜袭者触发 {card:虚假目标} 的能力，以避免该锁定标记。使用 {card:虚假目标} 满足了 {card:阿曼德·“游魂”·沃克} 能力的触发条件。由于这是最新满足触发条件的能力，因此 {card:阿曼德·“游魂”·沃克} 的能力必须最先结算，先于 {card:虚假目标} 避免 {card:圈套！} 所赋予的锁定标记，也先于 {card:圈套！} 完成结算。潜袭者通过 {card:阿曼德·“游魂”·沃克} 抽 1 张卡牌，用 {card:虚假目标} 避免来自 {card:圈套！} 的锁定标记，最后再受到（并存活于）3 点网域伤害。

original: 9.1.2.b. An ability "is resolving" from when its first instruction becomes imminent until its last instruction has finished resolving. See also {ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}. An event or operation "is resolving" throughout {ref:rule_steps_playing_resolve_play_abilities} of playing that event or operation.
translation: 一项能力自其第一条指示变为即将发生时起，到其最后一条指示结算完毕为止，均视为“正在结算”。另见{ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}。一张事件或事务在被打出的{ref:rule_steps_playing_resolve_play_abilities}期间也视为“正在结算”。

original: The Corp resolves a subroutine on {card:Attini} while its first ability is active. The subroutine is resolving during the interrupt window for its instruction, so the Runner cannot spend credits during that window and will not be able to use {card:Caldera}'s ability to prevent net damage.
translation: 公司在 {card:切叶蚁} 的第一个能力处于活动状态时，结算其一个子进程。该子进程在其指示的打断窗口中正处于结算中，因此潜袭者不能在该窗口中花费信用点，也不能使用 {card:火山臼} 的能力来防止网域伤害。

original: The Runner is playing {card:Zahya Sadeghi: Versatile Smuggler} and plays {card:Direct Access} to run HQ. The static ability on {card:Direct Access} removes {card:Zahya Sadeghi}'s ability while it is resolving. Normally, that ability would meet its trigger condition and resolve immediately after the "Run any server." instruction. This reaction window is outside of the run, but it is still part of {card:Direct Access} resolving, so the ability is not present at the needed time and cannot be triggered or resolved.
translation: 潜袭者使用 {card:扎赫亚·萨迪吉：多才多艺的走私者} 作为特性，并打出 {card:单刀直入} 以潜袭总部。{card:单刀直入} 上的持续能力会在其结算期间移除 {card:扎赫亚·萨迪吉} 的能力。通常，该能力会在“潜袭任意服务器。”这条指示之后立即满足触发条件并结算。该响应窗口位于潜袭之外，但它仍然是 {card:单刀直入} 结算过程的一部分，因此在所需时点，该能力并不存在，也就不能被触发或结算。

original: 9.1.3. The {term:source} of an ability is the card, counter, or game rule that originated it.
translation: 一项能力的{term:来源}，是产生该能力的卡牌、指示物或游戏规则。

original: 9.1.3.a. Each card is the source of its own printed abilities.
translation: 每张卡牌都是其自身印刷能力的来源。

original: 9.1.3.b. If something grants an ability to an object (see {ref:rule_gaining_losing_abilities}), the source of the granted ability is that object, not whatever granted the ability.
translation: 如果某个事物赋予一个物件一项能力（见{ref:rule_gaining_losing_abilities}），则被赋予能力的来源是该物件本身，而不是赋予它该能力的事物。

original: 9.1.3.c. The source of an ability that is being maintained by a lingering effect is the object that created that lingering effect. See {ref:sec_lingering_effects}.
translation: 一项由残留效果维持存在的能力，其来源是创造该残留效果的物件。见{ref:sec_lingering_effects}。

original: 9.1.4. Each paid ability, conditional ability, and subroutine becomes independent of its source at a certain point before it resolves, as described in {ref:rule_paid_ability_independent,rule_conditional_ability_independent,rule_subroutine_independent}, respectively. If the source changes zones after that point, the ability cannot act on the source.
translation: 每项付费能力、条件能力与子进程，都会在其结算之前的某个时点变得独立于其来源，如{ref:rule_paid_ability_independent,rule_conditional_ability_independent,rule_subroutine_independent}分别所述。如果其来源在该时点之后改变区域，则该能力不能作用于其来源。

original: The runner plays {card:Compile}, uses it to install {card:Mayfly} during the resulting run, and breaks subroutines with {card:Mayfly} during that run. When the run ends, delayed conditional abilities from both {card:Mayfly} and {card:Compile} become pending. The Runner decides to resolve {card:Compile} first, adding {card:Mayfly} to the bottom of their stack. The Runner then resolves the ability from {card:Mayfly}, which instructs them to trash its source program. Because {card:Mayfly} has changed zones, the copy of it on the bottom of the stack is a new object. With nothing to trash, the ability from {card:Mayfly} does nothing.
translation: 潜袭者打出 {card:编译}，并在由此产生的潜袭中用它安装 {card:蜉蝣}，又在该次潜袭中用 {card:蜉蝣} 破解子进程。当潜袭结束时，来自 {card:蜉蝣} 与 {card:编译} 的延时条件能力都会变为待结算。潜袭者决定先结算 {card:编译}，将 {card:蜉蝣} 加入其存储栈底部。然后，潜袭者结算来自 {card:蜉蝣} 的能力，该能力会指示其销毁其来源程序。由于 {card:蜉蝣} 已经改变区域，位于存储栈底部的那个副本已是新物件。既然没有可销毁的对象，来自 {card:蜉蝣} 的能力便不作任何事。

original: 9.1.5. Whereas an ability, instruction, or declaration is made up of text, an {term:effect} is what happens in the game because of that text.
translation: 能力、指示或声明由文本构成，而{term:效果}则是这些文本在游戏中所产生的结果。

original: 9.1.5.a. Any of a non-static ability's effects that apply beyond the duration of that ability's resolution become independent of that ability and its source. The game engine takes responsibility for managing these {term:lingering effects} directly, and deletes them from the game state as their durations expire. See {ref:sec_lingering_effects}.
translation: 任何非持续能力的效果，只要其适用时间超出该能力结算持续期间，便会独立于该能力及其来源。游戏引擎会直接负责管理这些{term:残留效果}，并在其持续时间失效时将其从游戏状态中删除。见{ref:sec_lingering_effects}。

original: 9.1.6. Any time a player chooses to resolve an optional ability or an optional part of an ability, the player is considered to be {term:using} that ability and the source card of that ability. Players do not "use" abilities that are entirely mandatory.
translation: 每当玩家选择结算一个可选能力，或能力中的一个可选部分时，该玩家便被视为正在{term:使用}该能力以及该能力的来源卡牌。玩家不会“使用”完全强制的能力。

original: 9.1.6.a. A paid ability is considered used once the trigger cost has been paid. See {ref:sec_steps_of_using_a_paid_ability} for the steps of using a paid ability.
translation: 一项付费能力会在其触发费用被支付时被视为已使用。关于使用一项付费能力的步骤，见{ref:sec_steps_of_using_a_paid_ability}。

original: 9.1.6.b. A conditional ability is considered used once the relevant optional effects of the ability have been resolved by the controller of the ability. See {ref:sec_steps_of_triggering_and_resolving_a_conditional_ability} for the steps of triggering and resolving conditional abilities.
translation: 一项条件能力会在该能力的操控者结算了其相关的可选效果时，被视为已使用。关于触发与结算条件能力的步骤，见{ref:sec_steps_of_triggering_and_resolving_a_conditional_ability}。

original: 9.1.6.c. If an ability allows a player to spend or move counters, that ability's source card is considered used at the time the player pays a cost by spending or moving those counters, even if the counters are spent or moved from cards other than the card that is the source of that ability.
translation: 如果一项能力允许玩家花费或转移指示物，则在玩家通过花费或转移这些指示物来支付费用时，该能力的来源卡牌就会被视为已使用，即使这些指示物是从该能力来源卡牌以外的卡牌上被花费或转移的也是如此。

original: The Runner spends the credit hosted on {card:Cyberfeeder} to pay the trigger cost of {card:Mimic}'s ability. Because the Runner triggered {card:Mimic}'s paid ability and {card:Cyberfeeder}'s ability allowed the credit to be spent, both {card:Mimic} and {card:Cyberfeeder} have been used.
translation: 潜袭者花费附载于 {card:赛博补给器} 上的信用点，以支付 {card:变脸者} 能力的触发费用。由于潜袭者触发了 {card:变脸者} 的付费能力，而 {card:赛博补给器} 的能力又允许该信用点被花费，因此 {card:变脸者} 与 {card:赛博补给器} 都已被使用。

original: 9.1.7. Abilities are {term:active} if they are eligible to be resolved or apply to the current game state, and {term:inactive} otherwise. By default, a card's abilities are active if and only if that card is active (see {ref:rule_active_cards}). Abilities of counters are active for as long as the counter exists.
translation: 能力如果有资格结算，或有资格适用于当前游戏状态，则为{term:活动的}；否则为{term:闲置的}。默认情况下，一张卡牌的能力，当且仅当该卡牌处于活动状态时才是活动的（见{ref:rule_active_cards}）。指示物的能力则在该指示物存在期间始终处于活动状态。

original: 9.1.8. Some types of abilities are active even while their source card is inactive.
translation: 某些类型的能力即使其来源卡牌处于闲置状态，也仍然是活动的。

original: 9.1.8.a. Conditional abilities that meet their conditions when their source card is accessed are active even while that card is inactive.
translation: 当其来源卡牌被读取时会满足条件的条件能力，即使该卡牌处于闲置状态，也仍然是活动的。

original: 9.1.8.b. Abilities stating that they are active in a particular zone are active in that zone. Abilities that can only ever meet their conditions in a particular zone are active in that zone. Abilities that can only affect the game state from a particular zone are active in that zone. When determining whether these stipulations apply, refer only to the game rules, not to any other effects that may be changing how cards move between zones.
translation: 声明其在特定区域中处于活动状态的能力，会在该区域中处于活动状态。只可能在特定区域中满足其条件的能力，会在该区域中处于活动状态。只可能从特定区域影响游戏状态的能力，也会在该区域中处于活动状态。在判断这些规定是否适用时，只参考游戏规则本身，而不参考任何其他可能改变卡牌在区域间移动方式的效果。

original: {card:I've Had Worse} has an ability that meets its trigger condition when it is trashed due to damage. Normally, this can only occur by moving {card:I've Had Worse} from the grip to the heap. Therefore, this ability is active in the heap. However, if {card:I've Had Worse} is trashed, but the Corp uses {card:Skorpios Defense Systems} to remove it from the game instead of adding it to the heap, the ability is not active.
translation: {card:这还不算惨} 具有一个在其因伤害而被销毁时满足触发条件的能力。通常，这只会在将 {card:这还不算惨} 从操控器转移到堆阵时发生。因此，该能力在堆阵中处于活动状态。然而，如果 {card:这还不算惨} 被销毁，但公司使用 {card:蝎岛防御体系} 将其改为移出游戏，而不是加入堆阵，则该能力不是活动的。

original: 9.1.8.c. Abilities that modify when or if their source card can be played, installed, or rezzed are active even while that card is inactive.
translation: 会修改其来源卡牌是否能被打出、安装或激活，或会修改这些时机的能力，即使该卡牌处于闲置状态，也仍然是活动的。

original: 9.1.8.d. Abilities that modify the cost to install, rez, or play their source card are active even while that card is inactive.
translation: 会修改安装、激活或打出其来源卡牌费用的能力，即使该卡牌处于闲置状态，也仍然是活动的。

original: 9.1.8.e. Abilities that define or modify the advancement requirement of their source card or create an additional cost to steal their source card are active even while that card is inactive.
translation: 会定义或修改其来源卡牌推进需求，或为窃取其来源卡牌创造额外费用的能力，即使该卡牌处于闲置状态，也仍然是活动的。

original: 9.1.8.f. Abilities allowing a card to be advanced are active even while that card is unrezzed.
translation: 允许一张卡牌被推进的能力，即使该卡牌处于未激活状态，也仍然是活动的。

original: 9.1.8.g. If an active card moves to a zone where it is inactive, an ability of that card with a trigger condition that is met by this zone change remains active in the card's new location until any corresponding instances of the ability resolve. See {ref:rule_pending_instances} for information about instances of conditional abilities.
translation: 如果一张活动中的卡牌转移到一个其将处于闲置状态的区域，而该卡牌上的某项能力的触发条件正是由这次区域变化所满足，则该能力会在该卡牌的新位置中保持活动，直到该能力的任何对应实例结算完毕。关于条件能力的实例，见{ref:rule_pending_instances}。

original: The Runner uses {card:Singularity} to simultaneously trash a rezzed {card:Hostile Infrastructure} and 2 upgrades. Those cards are moved to Archives and become inactive, but {card:Hostile Infrastructure}'s ability remains active, and 3 instances will become pending, each doing 1 net damage when it resolves. Once all those instances are resolved, {card:Hostile Infrastructure}'s ability stops being active.
translation: 潜袭者使用 {card:奇点}，同时销毁一张已激活的 {card:敌意架构} 与 2 个升级。这些卡牌被转移到档案库中并变为闲置状态，但 {card:敌意架构} 的能力仍然保持活动，并将有 3 个实例变为待结算，每个实例在结算时造成 1 点网域伤害。待这些实例全部结算后，{card:敌意架构} 的能力才停止处于活动状态。

original: The Runner plays {card:Test Run} to install {card:Nanuq}. When their turn ends, {card:Test Run}'s delayed conditional ability adds {card:Nanuq} to the top of the Runner's stack. This meets the trigger condition of {card:Nanuq}'s first ability, which remains active until it resolves even though {card:Nanuq} itself is inactive in the stack. The ability will move {card:Nanuq} from the top of the stack to the removed-from-game zone.
translation: 潜袭者打出 {card:测试运行} 来安装 {card:北极熊}。当其回合结束时，{card:测试运行} 的延时条件能力将 {card:北极熊} 加入潜袭者存储栈顶。这满足了 {card:北极熊} 第一个能力的触发条件；尽管 {card:北极熊} 在存储栈中本身处于闲置状态，该能力仍会保持活动直到结算。该能力会将 {card:北极熊} 从存储栈顶转移到移出游戏区。

original: 9.1.8.h. If a piece of ice is encountered while it is not installed, its subroutines are active during that encounter.
translation: 如果一层防火墙在未安装状态下被遭遇，则其子进程在该次遭遇期间仍然是活动的。

original: The Runner accesses {card:Archangel} from HQ, and the Corp uses its ability to force the Runner to encounter it. {card:Archangel}'s subroutine is active and can resolve during that encounter.
translation: 潜袭者从总部读取到 {card:大天使}，而公司使用其能力强迫潜袭者遭遇之。{card:大天使} 的子进程处于活动状态，并能在该次遭遇中结算。

original: 9.1.8.i. Persistent abilities can sometimes remain active after their source card is trashed. See {ref:subsec_persistent}.
translation: 持久能力在其来源卡牌被销毁后，有时仍能继续保持活动。见{ref:subsec_persistent}。

original: 9.1.9. Static abilities and lingering effects can make objects gain or lose abilities.
translation: 持续能力与残留效果可以使物件获得或失去能力。

original: 9.1.9.a. If an object loses an ability, that ability is completely ignored. If the lost ability is a subroutine, it is not considered by any effect that counts subroutines on that object.
translation: 如果一个物件失去一项能力，则该能力会被完全忽略。如果失去的是一条子进程，则任何计算该物件上子进程数量的效果都不会将其计入。

original: 9.1.9.b. To determine the actual abilities present on an object (as well as its other characteristics), follow the procedure described in {ref:rule_dependent_effects} and {ref:rule_independent_effects}.
translation: 要确定一个物件实际上具有哪些能力（以及其其他特征），应遵循{ref:rule_dependent_effects}与{ref:rule_independent_effects}中描述的流程。

original: 9.1.9.c. Abilities on an object have no particular order, except for play abilities and subroutines. Play abilities cannot be added to or removed from an event or operation, and their order is the order they appear on their source card. To determine the order of subroutines on an object, refer to {ref:rule_subroutines_ordered} and {ref:rule_subroutine_origins}.
translation: 一个物件上的能力本身没有特定顺序，打出能力与子进程除外。事件或事务上的打出能力不能被增加或移除，且其顺序即为其在来源卡牌上出现的顺序。要确定一个物件上子进程的顺序，见{ref:rule_subroutines_ordered}与{ref:rule_subroutine_origins}。

original: 9.2. Timing and Priority
translation: 时机与优先权

original: 9.2.1. The {term:active player} is the player whose turn it is. The other player is the {term:inactive player}.
translation: {term:主动玩家}是当前轮到其回合的玩家。另一位玩家则为{term:非主动玩家}。

original: 9.2.2. A {term:timing structure} is a unit of the game in which a prescribed sequence of steps progress the game forward.
translation: {term:时序}是游戏中的一个单位，其中按规定顺序推进的一系列步骤会推动游戏继续进行。

original: 9.2.2.a. The Corp's turn and the Runner's turn are timing structures, as are each of the 3 phases of the turns. See {ref:chpt_turns}.
translation: 公司的回合与潜袭者的回合都是时序，回合中的 3 个阶段也都是时序。见{ref:chpt_turns}。

original: 9.2.2.b. A run is a timing structure, as are each of the 6 phases of a run. See {ref:chpt_runs}.
translation: 一次潜袭是一个时序，潜袭的 6 个阶段也都是时序。见{ref:chpt_runs}。

original: 9.2.2.c. Breaching a server is a timing structure. See {ref:sec_breaching_servers,sec_breaching_steps}.
translation: 侵入一台服务器是一个时序。见{ref:sec_breaching_servers,sec_breaching_steps}。

original: 9.2.2.d. Accessing a card is a timing structure. See {ref:sec_accessing_cards,sec_steps_accessing_card}.
translation: 读取一张卡牌是一个时序。见{ref:sec_accessing_cards,sec_steps_accessing_card}。

original: 9.2.2.e. Other procedures with prescribed steps, such as installing a card or resolving a trace attempt, are not timing structures.
translation: 其他具有规定步骤的流程，如安装一张卡牌或结算一次追踪尝试，不属于时序。

original: 9.2.3. {term:Priority} is a player's opportunity to act and make certain game choices. No more than one player can have priority at any given time.
translation: {term:优先权}是玩家采取行动并作出某些游戏选择的机会。在任一给定时刻，不会有超过一位玩家拥有优先权。

original: 9.2.4. A {term:priority window} is a general term for a timing step in which one or both players receive priority. Priority windows {term:open} for different purposes throughout the game. When a priority window {term:closes}, the game continues to the next timing step.
translation: {term:优先权窗口}是一个总称，指一个或两位玩家获得优先权的时序步骤。优先权窗口会在游戏过程中因不同目的而{term:开放}。当一个优先权窗口关闭时，游戏继续进入下一个时序步骤。

original: 9.2.4.a. All priority windows give the player with priority the option to choose a relevant ability they control (if there are any) as the next ability for the game to resolve. This is often referred to as {term:triggering} the chosen ability. Some priority windows also give players other options.
translation: 所有优先权窗口都会给予拥有优先权的玩家一个选项：从其操控的相关能力中（若有）选择一项，作为游戏接下来要结算的能力。这通常称为{term:触发}所选择的能力。某些优先权窗口也会给予玩家其他选项。

original: 9.2.4.b. Except during action windows, the player with priority has the option to {term:pass} in addition to the available options defined by that priority window. When a player passes, the game progresses to the next step, either by giving priority to the other player or by closing the priority window. Each type of priority window defines the method and resolution of passing.
translation: 除行动窗口外，拥有优先权的玩家除了该优先权窗口所定义的其他可用选项外，还可以选择{term:让过}。当一位玩家让过时，游戏会进入下一步骤，要么将优先权交给另一位玩家，要么关闭该优先权窗口。每种优先权窗口都会定义让过的方式与结算方式。

original: 9.2.4.c. Unless otherwise noted, the player with priority receives priority again after resolving one of their available options. That player will continue to receive priority until they pass.
translation: 除非另有说明，拥有优先权的玩家在结算完其可用选项之一后，会再次获得优先权。该玩家会持续获得优先权，直到其让过为止。

original: 9.2.4.d. While a priority window is open, another nested priority window can open as well. This nesting allows the game to resolve "chain reactions," as discussed in {ref:rule_chain_reaction}. The most recently opened priority window is always resolved before returning to an earlier priority window.
translation: 在一个优先权窗口开启期间，另一个嵌套的优先权窗口也可以开启。这种嵌套使游戏能够结算如{ref:rule_chain_reaction}所述的“连锁反应”。最近开启的优先权窗口总会先于较早的优先权窗口被结算。

original: 9.2.4.e. Whenever a player receives priority during a priority window, a checkpoint occurs immediately before that player may act. See {ref:sec_checkpoints}.
translation: 每当一位玩家在优先权窗口中获得优先权时，在该玩家可以行动之前都会立刻发生一次检查点。见{ref:sec_checkpoints}。

original: 9.2.5. The types of priority windows are action windows, paid ability windows, reaction windows, interrupt windows, and mid-access ability windows.
translation: 优先权窗口的类型包括行动窗口、付费能力窗口、响应窗口、打断窗口，以及读取时能力窗口。

original: 9.2.6. An {term:action window} is a priority window that opens during a player's action phase if they have unspent clicks.
translation: {term:行动窗口}是一个优先权窗口，会在玩家行动阶段中且其仍有未花费时点时开启。

original: 9.2.6.a. An action window gives only the active player priority.
translation: 行动窗口只给予主动玩家优先权。

original: 9.2.6.b. During an action window, the active player must take an action. {ref:Sec_actions} discusses actions. This type of window does not give the option to pass.
translation: 在行动窗口中，主动玩家必须执行一个行动。关于行动，见{ref:Sec_actions}。这种窗口不提供让过的选项。

original: 9.2.6.c. After the active player takes an action, the action window closes and the game moves to the next timing step. The player does not receive priority again.
translation: 在主动玩家执行了一个行动后，行动窗口关闭，游戏进入下一个时序步骤。该玩家不会再次获得优先权。

original: 9.2.6.d. There are two timing steps during which an action window may open. The Corp has an action window in {ref:step_corp_turn_action} of their action phase. The Runner has an action window in {ref:step_runner_turn_action} of their action phase.
translation: 行动窗口可能会在两个时序步骤中开启。公司在其行动阶段的{ref:step_corp_turn_action}拥有一个行动窗口。潜袭者在其行动阶段的{ref:step_runner_turn_action}拥有一个行动窗口。

original: 9.2.7. A {term:paid ability window} is a priority window that opens throughout the game's timing structures to allow players to trigger paid abilities, rez cards, or score agendas.
translation: {term:付费能力窗口}是一个优先权窗口，会在游戏的各个时序中开启，以允许玩家触发付费能力、激活卡牌或计分议案。

original: 9.2.7.a. Paid ability windows give both players priority, starting with the active player. When a player passes, the other player receives priority. Players continue to exchange priority until a player who receives priority from their opponent passes without resolving any other option available to them. Once this happens, the paid ability window closes.
translation: 付费能力窗口会给予双方玩家优先权，并从主动玩家开始。当一位玩家让过时，另一位玩家获得优先权。玩家会持续轮流交换优先权，直到一位从对手那里获得优先权的玩家在不结算其任何其他可用选项的情况下让过。一旦如此，付费能力窗口便关闭。

original: 9.2.7.b. During every paid ability window, the player with priority has the option to trigger an active paid ability they control. Players cannot trigger actions, interrupts, or mid-access abilities in a paid ability window. See {ref:sec_paid_abilities}. Within this document, paid ability windows are marked with the symbol (P) to denote the option to trigger a regular paid ability.
translation: 在每个付费能力窗口中，拥有优先权的玩家都可以触发其操控的一项活动付费能力。玩家不能在付费能力窗口中触发行动、打断或读取时能力。见{ref:sec_paid_abilities}。在本文档中，付费能力窗口以符号 (P) 标示，以表示可触发常规付费能力的选项。

original: 9.2.7.c. During some paid ability windows, the Corp has the option to rez an asset or upgrade while they have priority. Within this document, the symbol (R) denotes a paid ability window in which cards can be rezzed. See {ref:sec_faceup_facedown_status}.
translation: 在某些付费能力窗口中，公司在拥有优先权时可以激活资产或升级。在本文档中，符号 (R) 表示一个可以激活卡牌的付费能力窗口。见{ref:sec_faceup_facedown_status}。

original: 9.2.7.d. During some paid ability windows, the Corp has the option to score an agenda while they have priority. Within this document, the symbol (S) denotes a paid ability window in which agendas can be scored. See {ref:sec_score_scoring_steal}.
translation: 在某些付费能力窗口中，公司在拥有优先权时可以计分议案。在本文档中，符号 (S) 表示一个可以计分议案的付费能力窗口。见{ref:sec_score_scoring_steal}。

original: 9.2.7.e. During the paid ability window at {ref:step_approach_paw} of the Approach Ice Phase of a run, the Corp has the option to rez the piece of ice the Runner is approaching while they have priority.
translation: 在潜袭的接驳防火墙阶段中{ref:step_approach_paw}的付费能力窗口内，公司在拥有优先权时可以激活潜袭者正在接驳的那层防火墙。

original: 9.2.7.f. The player with priority during a paid ability window may use any of the options available to them any number of times in any combination and order until they decide to pass, so long as they are allowed and the player pays any and all costs to use each option. Each option must be fully resolved before another is chosen. A player is not obligated to resolve any of the options available to them, except they must pass.
translation: 在付费能力窗口中，拥有优先权的玩家可以按任意组合与顺序，任意次数地使用其所有可用选项，直到其决定让过为止；前提是这些选项被允许使用，且该玩家为每次使用都支付全部费用。每个选项都必须在选择下一个选项之前完全结算。玩家没有义务结算其可用的任何选项，唯一必须做的是让过。

original: 9.2.7.g. Paid ability windows occur throughout the timing steps of turns and runs. {ref:Sec_steps_corp_turn,sec_steps_runner_turn,sec_steps_of_a_run} detail those steps and indicate which options are available in which windows. {ref:Chpt_appendix_timing_structures} also contains a summarized version of these steps.
translation: 付费能力窗口会在回合与潜袭的各个时序步骤中出现。{ref:Sec_steps_corp_turn,sec_steps_runner_turn,sec_steps_of_a_run}详列了这些步骤，并指出各窗口中有哪些选项可用。{ref:Chpt_appendix_timing_structures}也包含这些步骤的摘要版。

original: 9.2.8. A {term:reaction window} is a priority window that opens whenever one or more active conditional abilities become pending by meeting their conditions. {ref:Sec_conditional_abilities} discusses conditional abilities.
translation: {term:响应窗口}是一个优先权窗口，会在一项或多项活动条件能力因满足其条件而变为待结算时开启。关于条件能力，见{ref:Sec_conditional_abilities}。

original: 9.2.8.a. Each reaction window is associated with the fixed set of conditional abilities that met their conditions just before the window opened. If other abilities become pending during a reaction window, a separate reaction window opens to handle the new abilities. See {ref:rule_chain_reaction}.
translation: 每个响应窗口都与窗口开启之前刚刚满足条件的那组固定条件能力相关联。如果其他能力在响应窗口中变为待结算，则会开启另一个独立的响应窗口来处理这些新能力。见{ref:rule_chain_reaction}。

original: 9.2.8.b. Reaction windows give both players priority, starting with the active player. When the active player passes, the inactive player receives priority. When the inactive player passes, the reaction window closes.
translation: 响应窗口会给予双方玩家优先权，并从主动玩家开始。当主动玩家让过时，非主动玩家获得优先权。当非主动玩家让过时，响应窗口关闭。

original: 9.2.8.c. During a reaction window, the player with priority has the option to trigger a pending conditional ability they control that is associated with that window.
translation: 在响应窗口中，拥有优先权的玩家可以触发一项由其操控、与该窗口相关联且处于待结算状态的条件能力。

original: 9.2.8.d. The player with priority during a reaction window may trigger their pending abilities in any order until they decide to pass; they do not need to trigger mandatory abilities before optional ones. Each ability they trigger must be fully resolved before another is chosen.
translation: 在响应窗口中，拥有优先权的玩家可以按任意顺序触发其待结算能力，直到其决定让过为止；其无须先触发强制能力再触发可选能力。每个被其触发的能力都必须在选择下一项之前完全结算。

original: 9.2.8.e. The player with priority cannot pass if they control any pending mandatory abilities. They may pass with optional conditional abilities still pending, in which case those abilities lose their pending status without being triggered. {ref:Rule_optional_conditional_ability} describes the differences between mandatory and optional conditional abilities.
translation: 如果拥有优先权的玩家操控任何待结算的强制能力，则其不能让过。其可以在仍有可选条件能力处于待结算状态时让过，在这种情况下，这些能力会失去待结算状态而不会被触发。{ref:Rule_optional_conditional_ability}描述了强制与可选条件能力之间的差异。

original: 9.2.8.f. If a reaction window opens due to a timing structure beginning, and during that reaction window the timing structure ends (e.g. by an effect moving the game to another timing point past the end of the structure), then the reaction window immediately closes. All remaining abilities associated with the window lose their pending status without being triggered, even if they are mandatory abilities.
translation: 如果一个响应窗口因某个时序开始而开启，而在该响应窗口中该时序结束了（例如因某个效果使游戏移到该时序结束之后的另一个时点），则该响应窗口会立即关闭。所有与该窗口相关联的剩余能力都会失去待结算状态而不被触发，即使它们是强制能力也是如此。

original: The Runner has a {card:Femme Fatale} installed and chose a {card:Tollbooth} with its "when installed" ability. When the Runner encounters the {card:Tollbooth}, they pay 1[c] to bypass the {card:Tollbooth} with {card:Femme Fatale}. Because the resolution of {card:Femme Fatale}'s ability causes the encounter to end, the pending ability from {card:Tollbooth} cannot be triggered. The Runner does not pay 3[c], and the run does not end.
translation: 潜袭者已安装一张 {card:蛇蝎美人}，并通过其“when installed”能力选择了一张 {card:收费站}。当潜袭者遭遇 {card:收费站} 时，其支付 1[c]，以 {card:蛇蝎美人} 略过该张 {card:收费站}。由于 {card:蛇蝎美人} 能力的结算导致该次遭遇结束，因此来自 {card:收费站} 的待结算能力不能被触发。潜袭者不会支付 3[c]，而该次潜袭也不会结束。

original: 9.2.9. An {term:interrupt window} is a priority window that opens just before an instruction would resolve when one or more players have abilities that could modify that imminent instruction. See {ref:sec_interrupts_replacements} for rules about interrupt abilities.
translation: {term:打断窗口}是一个优先权窗口，会在一条指示即将结算之前开启，前提是一位或多位玩家拥有可能修改该即将发生之指示的能力。关于打断能力的规则，见{ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}。

original: 9.2.9.a. Each interrupt window is associated with the single imminent instruction being modified by the abilities triggered during the window, and with a fixed set of conditional ability interrupts determined as the window opens.
translation: 每个打断窗口都与窗口中被触发能力所修改的那一条单独的即将发生指示，以及在窗口开启时确定的一组固定条件能力打断相关联。

original: 9.2.9.b. As an interrupt window opens, before players receive priority, the expected effects of the imminent instruction are determined, any applicable replacement effects are applied, and then relevant conditional abilities become pending. See {ref:sec_interrupt_window_for_imminent_instruction}.
translation: 当一个打断窗口开启时，在玩家获得优先权之前，先确定该即将发生指示的预期效果，适用任何可适用的替代效果，然后相关条件能力变为待结算。见{ref:sec_interrupt_window_for_imminent_instruction}。

original: 9.2.9.c. Interrupt windows give both players priority, starting with the active player. When a player passes, the other player receives priority. Players continue to exchange priority until a player who receives priority from their opponent passes without resolving any other option available to them. Once this happens, the interrupt window closes.
translation: 打断窗口会给予双方玩家优先权，并从主动玩家开始。当一位玩家让过时，另一位玩家获得优先权。玩家会持续轮流交换优先权，直到一位从对手那里获得优先权的玩家在不结算其任何其他可用选项的情况下让过。一旦如此，打断窗口便关闭。

original: 9.2.9.d. During an interrupt window, the player with priority has the option to trigger an interrupt ability they control that is relevant to the imminent effect. See {ref:sec_relevant_interrupts}.
translation: 在打断窗口中，拥有优先权的玩家可以触发一项由其操控、且与该即将发生效果相关的打断能力。见{ref:sec_relevant_interrupts}。

original: 9.2.9.e. The player with priority during an interrupt window may trigger their abilities in any order until they decide to pass. They do not need to trigger mandatory abilities before optional abilities or trigger conditional abilities before paid abilities. Each ability they trigger must be fully resolved before another is chosen.
translation: 在打断窗口中，拥有优先权的玩家可以按任意顺序触发其能力，直到其决定让过为止。其无须先触发强制能力再触发可选能力，也无须先触发条件能力再触发付费能力。每项被其触发的能力都必须在选择下一项之前完全结算。

original: 9.2.9.f. The player with priority cannot pass if they control any pending mandatory abilities that are still relevant to the imminent effect. They may pass with optional conditional abilities still pending. ({ref:Rule_optional_conditional_ability} describes the differences between mandatory and optional conditional abilities.) Once a player has passed, if they receive priority again, they may continue to trigger paid abilities and pending conditional abilities that are relevant. As the interrupt window closes, any remaining pending conditional abilities lose their pending status.
translation: 如果拥有优先权的玩家操控任何仍与该即将发生效果相关的待结算强制能力，则其不能让过。其可以在仍有可选条件能力处于待结算状态时让过。（{ref:Rule_optional_conditional_ability}描述了强制与可选条件能力之间的差异。）一旦玩家已经让过，如果其再次获得优先权，则仍可继续触发相关的付费能力与待结算条件能力。当打断窗口关闭时，任何剩余的待结算条件能力都会失去待结算状态。

original: 9.2.10. A {term:mid-access ability window} is a priority window that opens while the Runner is accessing a card.
translation: {term:读取时能力窗口}是一个优先权窗口，会在潜袭者读取一张卡牌时开启。

original: 9.2.10.a. A mid-access ability window gives only the Runner priority.
translation: 读取时能力窗口只给予潜袭者优先权。

original: 9.2.10.b. During a mid-access ability window, the Runner may use a mid-access ability or may pass. In addition to any mid-access abilities available from cards, the Runner may use the basic trash ability (see {ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}).
translation: 在读取时能力窗口中，潜袭者可以使用一个读取时能力，也可以让过。除卡牌提供的任何读取时能力外，潜袭者还可以使用基础销毁能力（见{ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}）。

original: 9.2.10.c. After the Runner uses a mid-access ability or passes, the mid-access ability window closes and the game moves to the next timing step. The Runner does not receive priority again.
translation: 在潜袭者使用了一个读取时能力或让过之后，读取时能力窗口就会关闭，游戏进入下一个时序步骤。潜袭者不会再次获得优先权。

original: 9.2.10.d. The only point at which a mid-access ability window occurs is at {ref:step_mid_access_ability} of accessing a card.
translation: 读取时能力窗口唯一出现的时点，是读取一张卡牌的{ref:step_mid_access_ability}。

original: 9.3. Interpreting Card Text
translation: 解释卡牌文本

original: 9.3.1. Text is classified into conditions, restrictions, instructions, declarations, and ability flags. The rules text of an ability can contain text in any combination of these classes, except that no ability contains both instructions and declarations.
translation: 文本会分为条件、限制、指示、声明与能力标记。能力的规则文本可以包含这些类别中的任意组合，但没有任何能力会同时包含指示与声明。

original: 9.3.2. A {term:condition} is a unit of text that stipulates a requirement for when an ability's effects are allowed to apply.
translation: {term:条件}是一段文本单元，用于规定能力效果何时被允许适用的要求。

original: 9.3.2.a. A {term:cost condition} describes a cost (either a nested cost or a trigger cost) that a player must pay to apply an effect. Costs are discussed in detail in {ref:sec_costs}.
translation: {term:费用条件}描述了玩家为适用某个效果必须支付的一项费用（可以是内部费用，也可以是触发费用）。费用的详细规则见{ref:sec_costs}。

original: 9.3.2.b. A {term:trigger condition} describes a change in game state that must occur for an effect to apply. Trigger conditions often begin with words such as "if", "when", "whenever", or "after", or with ordinal phrases such as "the first time".
translation: {term:触发条件}描述了必须发生的游戏状态变化，以使某个效果得以适用。触发条件通常以“if”“when”“whenever”或“after”等词开头，或以“the first time”等序数短语开头。

original: 9.3.2.c. A {term:static condition} describes a property of the game state that must be true for an effect to apply. Static conditions often begin with words such as "if", "during", or "while".
translation: {term:静态条件}描述了必须为真的某种游戏状态属性，以使某个效果得以适用。静态条件通常以“if”“during”或“while”等词开头。

original: 9.3.3. A {term:restriction} is a unit of text that applies one of a specific set of constraints for a card to be played or an ability to be used. If a restriction appears in an ability, it applies to the entire ability regardless of whether it is written before, after, or in the middle of the ability's other text. Many restrictions fall under {ref:rule_ability_active_inactive_source_card}, meaning they are active even while their source is inactive.
translation: {term:限制}是一段文本单元，它对卡牌被打出或能力被使用施加某一组特定约束之一。如果一个限制出现在某项能力中，则无论它是写在该能力其他文本的前面、后面还是中间，都会适用于整项能力。许多限制属于{ref:rule_ability_active_inactive_source_card}所述情况，意味着即使其来源处于闲置状态，它们也仍然是活动的。

original: 9.3.3.a. Text modifying the cost to play, install, rez, or steal the card it appears on is a restriction, including text that adds an additional cost.
translation: 修改其所在卡牌之打出、安装、激活或窃取费用的文本，包括添加额外费用的文本，都属于限制。

original: 9.3.3.b. Constraints on when or where a card can be installed, rezzed, played, or scored are restrictions.
translation: 对卡牌何时或何地可以被安装、激活、打出或计分所施加的约束，属于限制。

original: 9.3.3.c. Limits on when, where, or how often an ability can be used are restrictions.
translation: 对能力何时、何地或多久能被使用一次所施加的限制，属于限制。

original: 9.3.3.d. Constraints on how a cost can be paid are restrictions.
translation: 对一项费用如何支付所施加的约束，属于限制。

original: 9.3.3.e. If a card's text limits what cards it can host, the text describing that limit is a restriction. See also {ref:rule_host_via_ability}.
translation: 如果一张卡牌的文本限制了它可以附载哪些卡牌，则描述该限制的文本属于限制。另见{ref:rule_host_via_ability}。

original: 9.3.3.f. Definitions for or constraints on a variable are restrictions.
translation: 对某个变量所作的定义或约束，属于限制。

original: Some abilities dictate a value for X, such as "X is the number of rezzed NEXT ice." Some abilities with X in their cost constrain the value that can be chosen for X, such as "X must be equal to or less than the number of tags the Runner has." These statements are restrictions.
translation: 某些能力规定 X 的数值，例如“X is the number of rezzed NEXT ice.”。某些费用中包含 X 的能力会约束可为 X 选择的数值，例如“X must be equal to or less than the number of tags the Runner has.”。这些表述都属于限制。

original: 9.3.3.g. Stipulations that an effect or part of an effect cannot be prevented are restrictions.
translation: 说明某个效果或其一部分不能被防止的规定，属于限制。

original: 9.3.3.h. Any text not falling under one of the above categories is not a restriction.
translation: 任何不属于上述类别之一的文本，都不属于限制。

original: 9.3.4. An {term:instruction} is a statement or command that is resolved at a specific time and applies immediate effects to the game state. (This can include creating new lingering abilities or effects that will continue to apply over time; see {ref:sec_lingering_effects}.)
translation: 一项{term:指示}是一条会在特定时点结算，并对游戏状态施加即时效果的陈述或命令。（这可以包括创建会持续随时间适用的新残留能力或残留效果；见{ref:sec_lingering_effects}。）

original: 9.3.4.a. Instructions can originate from a game rule or from the text of an ability. An instruction in an ability resolves when that ability resolves (see {ref:rule_resolve_ability}). An instruction in the game rules resolves during the timing step(s) when it appears. {ref:Sec_identifying_instructions} explains how to determine the boundaries between consecutive instructions.
translation: 指示可以源自游戏规则，或源自某项能力的文本。一项能力中的指示会在该能力结算时结算（见{ref:rule_resolve_ability}）。游戏规则中的指示则在其出现的时序步骤中结算。{ref:Sec_identifying_instructions}说明了如何确定相邻指示之间的边界。

original: 9.3.4.b. If an instruction requires any targets, players announce those targets before that instruction becomes imminent. See {ref:sec_targets}.
translation: 如果一项指示需要任何目标，则玩家会在该指示变为即将发生之前宣告这些目标。见{ref:sec_targets}。

original: 9.3.4.c. Each instruction is carried out as an atomic unit and cannot be interrupted once it begins to resolve. The procedure for carrying out an instruction can be altered by other effects such as interrupts, but only before the instruction begins to resolve. See {ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}.
translation: 每项指示都作为一个原子单位执行，一旦开始结算便不能被打断。执行一项指示的流程可以被其他效果如打断所改变，但只能在该指示开始结算之前改变。见{ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}。

original: 9.3.4.d. Other than choosing targets, carry out the steps of a single instruction in the order they are written.
translation: 除选择目标外，单项指示中的各步骤都按其书写顺序执行。

original: 9.3.4.e. Instructions in an ability can create effects that last beyond the resolution of the ability. See {ref:sec_lingering_effects}.
translation: 一项能力中的指示可以创造在该能力结算之后仍持续存在的效果。见{ref:sec_lingering_effects}。

original: 9.3.5. A {term:declaration} is a statement describing an effect on components or game rules that is applied continuously. A declaration applies its effects as long as it is active.
translation: {term:声明}是一种文本陈述，用于描述一个持续适用于组件或游戏规则的效果。只要该声明处于活动状态，它的效果就会持续适用。

original: 9.3.6. An {term:ability flag} is a keyword or symbol that appears at the beginning of an ability. Ability flags are separated from the main text of the ability by an arrow (→). Each ability flag changes the rules for how the flagged ability functions.
translation: {term:能力标记}是出现在一项能力开头的关键词或符号。能力标记通过一个箭头（→）与能力主要文本分隔。每种能力标记都会改变该被标记能力的运作规则。

original: 9.3.6.a. There are six ability flags: access, interface, [interrupt], persistent, threat N, and once per turn.
translation: 能力标记共有六种：access、interface、[interrupt]、persistent、threat N 与 once per turn。

original: 9.3.6.b. The "access" flag appears on Runner card paid abilities and affects the timing for triggering those abilities. The Runner can use abilities with this flag only during the mid-access ability window at {ref:step_mid_access_ability} of accessing a card. See {ref:rule_mid_access_window}.
translation: “access”标记出现在潜袭者卡牌的付费能力上，并会影响触发这些能力的时机。潜袭者只能在读取一张卡牌的{ref:step_mid_access_ability}所对应的读取时能力窗口中使用带有此标记的能力。见{ref:rule_mid_access_window}。

original: 9.3.6.c. The "interface" flag appears on icebreaker paid abilities and affects the timing for triggering those abilities. The Runner can use abilities with this flag only during an encounter, and only if the ability's source is an icebreaker with strength that equals or exceeds the strength of the encountered ice. See {ref:subsec_icebreakers}.
translation: “interface”标记出现在破解器的付费能力上，并会影响触发这些能力的时机。潜袭者只能在一次遭遇中使用带有此标记的能力，且仅当该能力的来源是一个强度等于或高于被遭遇防火墙强度的破解器时才能如此。见{ref:subsec_icebreakers}。

original: 9.3.6.d. The interrupt flag ([interrupt]) appears on paid and conditional abilities and affects the timing for triggering those abilities. Players can use abilities with this flag only during interrupt windows, and only if the ability is relevant to the imminent instruction. See {ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}.
translation: 打断标记（[interrupt]）出现在付费能力和条件能力上，并会影响触发这些能力的时机。玩家只能在打断窗口中使用带有此标记的能力，且仅当该能力与即将发生的指示相关时才能如此。见{ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}。

original: 9.3.6.e. The "persistent" flag appears on Corp card abilities and changes the rules about when those abilities are active. An ability with this flag can persist until the end of the run after its source card is trashed. See {ref:subsec_persistent}.
translation: “persistent”标记出现在公司卡牌能力上，并会改变这些能力何时活动的规则。带有此标记的能力，在其来源卡牌被销毁后，可以继续生效直到潜袭结束。见{ref:subsec_persistent}。

original: 9.3.6.f. The "threat N" flag can appear on any type of ability. Abilities with this flag are only active if the threat level is greater than or equal to N, regardless of {ref:rule_ability_active_inactive_source_card}. See {ref:rule_threat_level}.
translation: “threat N”标记可以出现在任意类型的能力上。无论{ref:rule_ability_active_inactive_source_card}如何规定，带有此标记的能力只有在威胁等级大于或等于 N 时才是活动的。见{ref:rule_threat_level}。

original: 9.3.6.g. The "once per turn" flag appears on paid and conditional abilities. An ability with this flag can only be used once per turn. {ref:rule_using} explains what it means to "use" an ability.
translation: “once per turn”标记出现在付费能力与条件能力上。带有此标记的能力每回合只能使用一次。{ref:rule_using}说明了“使用”一项能力的含义。

original: The Runner is playing as {card:Zahya Sadeghi} and finishes a run on HQ, having accessed 1 card. They choose not to gain 1[c] with Zahya's ability. The ability was not "used", so its "once per turn" restriction has not been expended, even though the ability was able to resolve. The Runner can make another run later in the turn and gain credits with the ability.
translation: 潜袭者使用 {card:扎赫亚·萨迪吉} 作为特性，并完成了一次对总部的潜袭，读取了 1 张卡牌。其选择不通过 Zahya 的能力获得 1[c]。该能力并未被“使用”，因此其“每回合限一次”的限制尚未被耗尽，尽管该能力本来能够结算。潜袭者本回合稍后仍可以再进行一次潜袭，并通过该能力获得信用点。

original: 9.3.7. The five types of abilities can be identified by the types of text they are made of.
translation: 五种能力类型可以通过其文本构成类型来识别。

original: 9.3.7.a. Static abilities ({ref:sec_static_abilities}) can contain declarations, restrictions, and conditions, but never instructions. Static abilities are the only ability type that can contain declarations.
translation: 持续能力（{ref:sec_static_abilities}）可以包含声明、限制与条件，但绝不会包含指示。持续能力是唯一能够包含声明的能力类型。

original: 9.3.7.b. Paid abilities ({ref:sec_paid_abilities}) can always be identified by their formatting: a cost condition in bold text, a colon (:), then the remainder of the ability. The text after the colon can contain conditions, restrictions, and/or instructions.
translation: 付费能力（{ref:sec_paid_abilities}）始终可以通过其格式识别：粗体文本的费用条件、一个冒号（:），然后是其余能力文本。冒号之后的文本可以包含条件、限制和/或指示。

original: 9.3.7.c. Conditional abilities ({ref:sec_conditional_abilities}) always contain a trigger condition or static condition and at least one instruction. They can also contain restrictions, other instructions, or nested conditions. The primary condition is often written with a timing-related word or phrase like "when", "after", "the first time", and so on, and is usually the first part of the ability's text. Some older cards write the condition at the end of the ability or use "if" to indicate the condition.
translation: 条件能力（{ref:sec_conditional_abilities}）总是包含一个触发条件或静态条件，以及至少一条指示。它们还可以包含限制、其他指示，或嵌套条件。主要条件通常以诸如“when”“after”“the first time”等与时机有关的词句写出，并通常位于能力文本的开头。有些较旧卡牌会将条件写在能力末尾，或使用“if”来表示条件。

original: 9.3.7.d. Play abilities ({ref:sec_play_abilities}) are the abilities on events and operations that are not paid, conditional, or static abilities. They can contain conditions, restrictions, and/or instructions.
translation: 打出能力（{ref:sec_play_abilities}）是事件与事务上的能力中，既不是付费能力、条件能力，也不是持续能力的那些能力。它们可以包含条件、限制和/或指示。

original: 9.3.7.e. Subroutines ({ref:sec_subroutines}) always begin with the [sub] symbol, and can contain conditions, restrictions, and/or instructions.
translation: 子进程（{ref:sec_subroutines}）总是以[sub]符号开始，并且可以包含条件、限制和/或指示。

original: 9.4. Static Abilities
translation: 持续能力

original: 9.4.1. A {term:static ability} is an ability that continuously affects the game as long as it is active. Static abilities are the only type of ability that can contain declarations, and they do not resolve or have associated priority windows.
translation: {term:持续能力}是在其处于活动状态时持续影响游戏的一种能力。持续能力是唯一可以包含声明的能力类型，且它们不会被结算，也没有相关联的优先权窗口。

original: 9.4.2. If a static ability contains a static condition, then the constrained parts of the ability apply to the game state only if that condition is met.
translation: 如果一项持续能力包含静态条件，则该能力中受其约束的部分，只有在该条件满足时才适用于游戏状态。

original: 9.4.3. Static abilities can include restrictions that apply to their source card. These restrictions are often active even while the card is inactive. See {ref:rule_ability_active_inactive_source_card}.
translation: 持续能力可以包含适用于其来源卡牌的限制。这些限制经常在该卡牌处于闲置状态时也仍然是活动的。见{ref:rule_ability_active_inactive_source_card}。

original: 9.4.4. The effects of static abilities do not have durations and cannot directly create lingering effects (see {ref:sec_lingering_effects}).
translation: 持续能力的效果没有持续时间，且不能直接创建残留效果（见{ref:sec_lingering_effects}）。

original: The runner controls {card:Puffer} with a hosted {card:Gebrselassie}. {card:Gebrselassie} changes the durations of abilities affecting its host's strength, so if the Runner uses {card:Puffer}'s paid ability to give it +1 strength, that increase will last for the remainder of the turn. {card:Gebrselassie} does not affect {card:Puffer}'s static ability that increases its strength for each hosted power counter, so if the Runner spends [click] to remove a power counter, then the increase in strength from {card:Puffer}'s static ability will immediately be lost.
translation: 潜袭者操控一张附载了 {card:格布雷西拉西耶} 的 {card:河豚}。{card:格布雷西拉西耶} 会改变影响其宿主强度之能力的持续时间，因此如果潜袭者使用 {card:河豚} 的付费能力使其强度+1，该增幅会持续到本回合结束。{card:格布雷西拉西耶} 不会影响 {card:河豚} 那个会因附载能量指示物而提高其强度的持续能力，因此如果潜袭者花费[click]移除 1 枚能量指示物，那么来自 {card:河豚} 持续能力的强度提升会立刻失去。

original: 9.4.5. Static abilities that modify a value maintain the same restrictions and specifications that were present on the original value.
translation: 修改某个数值的持续能力，会保留原数值所具有的相同限制与规定。

original: {card:The Cleaners} has a static ability that gives every instance of meat damage done by the Corp +1 to the amount of the damage. Part of {card:Flare}'s effect does 2 meat damage that can't be prevented. If this effect resolves while {card:The Cleaners} is active, then all 3 points of meat damage are unpreventable.
translation: {card:清除者} 具有一项持续能力，使公司造成的每次肢体伤害都对伤害数量+1。{card:耀斑} 的部分效果会造成 2 点不能被防止的肢体伤害。如果该效果在 {card:清除者} 处于活动状态时结算，则这 3 点肢体伤害全部都不能被防止。

original: 9.5. Paid Abilities
translation: 付费能力

original: 9.5.1. A {term:paid ability} is an ability players trigger at-will, during appropriate priority windows. In order to use a paid ability, the controller of that ability must pay its {term:trigger cost}. Paid abilities are always written with the trigger cost first, followed by a colon (:), followed by the remainder of the ability's text.
translation: {term:付费能力}是玩家在适当的优先权窗口中，按自己意愿触发的一种能力。为了使用一项付费能力，该能力的操控者必须支付其{term:触发费用}。付费能力总是先写触发费用，再写一个冒号（:），然后是该能力文本的其余部分。

original: 9.5.2. A player can trigger paid abilities they control while they have priority in an appropriate priority window.
translation: 玩家可以在适当的优先权窗口中，于其拥有优先权时触发其操控的付费能力。

original: 9.5.2.a. If the trigger cost of a paid ability begins with a [click] symbol, the ability is an {term:action}. A player can use one action paid ability during each action window on their turn. See {ref:rule_action_window} and {ref:sec_actions}.
translation: 如果一项付费能力的触发费用以[click]符号开头，则该能力是一项{term:行动}。玩家在自己回合的每个行动窗口中可以使用一项行动类付费能力。见{ref:rule_action_window}与{ref:sec_actions}。

original: 9.5.2.b. If the [interrupt] flag appears before a paid ability's trigger cost, that ability is an interrupt. A player can use interrupt paid abilities during appropriate interrupt windows. Each such ability can be used as many times as its effects could apply to the imminent instruction. See {ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}.
translation: 如果某项付费能力的触发费用前带有[interrupt]标记，则该能力是一项打断。玩家可以在适当的打断窗口中使用付费打断能力。只要其效果可能适用于该即将发生的指示，每项此类能力都可以被使用任意多次。见{ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}。

original: 9.5.2.c. If the "access" flag appears before a paid ability's trigger cost, that ability is a mid-access ability. The Runner can use up to 1 mid-access ability during the mid-access ability window at {ref:step_mid_access_ability} of accessing a card.
translation: 如果某项付费能力的触发费用前带有“access”标记，则该能力是一项读取时能力。潜袭者在读取一张卡牌的{ref:step_mid_access_ability}所对应的读取时能力窗口中，至多可以使用 1 项读取时能力。

original: 9.5.2.d. If the "interface" flag appears before a paid ability's trigger cost, that ability is an Interface ability and is subject to the restrictions of icebreakers discussed in {ref:subsec_icebreakers}. Interface abilities do not have a special priority window type.
translation: 如果某项付费能力的触发费用前带有“interface”标记，则该能力是一项对接能力，并受{ref:subsec_icebreakers}中所讨论之破解器限制约束。对接能力并没有一种特殊的优先权窗口类型。

original: 9.5.2.e. Certain paid abilities can only be used at times appropriate to their effects, as detailed in {ref:rule_paid_ability_effect_based_timing_restrictions}.
translation: 某些付费能力只能在与其效果相适应的时机被使用，详见{ref:rule_paid_ability_effect_based_timing_restrictions}。

original: 9.5.2.f. A paid ability that is not an action, interrupt, or mid-access ability can be used during a paid ability window. Each such ability can be used an unlimited number of times as long as its cost is paid each time and any restrictions specified in its text or by other abilities are observed.
translation: 不是行动、打断或读取时能力的付费能力，可以在付费能力窗口中使用。只要每次都支付其费用，并遵守其文本或其他能力所规定的任何限制，每项此类能力都可以被无限次使用。

original: 9.5.3. Paid abilities are always optional. A paid ability and its source are considered used when the ability's trigger cost is paid.
translation: 付费能力总是可选的。一项付费能力及其来源，会在该能力的触发费用被支付时被视为已使用。

original: 9.5.3.a. Mid-access abilities the Runner is forced to trigger still count as optional abilities. See also {ref:rule_access_installed_must_trash_if_able} and {ref:rule_access_reveal_trash_if_able}.
translation: 即使潜袭者被迫触发的读取时能力，仍然算作可选能力。另见{ref:rule_access_installed_must_trash_if_able}与{ref:rule_access_reveal_trash_if_able}。

original: The Corp resolves the subroutine on {card:Wendigo}, prohibiting the Runner from using their installed {card:Imp} for the remainder of the run. Later, the Runner accesses an installed {card:Mumbad Virtual Tour}. Even though {card:Mumbad Virtual Tour} forces the Runner to trash it if able, {card:Imp}'s ability is still optional for purposes of {card:Wendigo}'s prohibition. Since {card:Imp}'s ability cannot be used at all this run, {card:Mumbad Virtual Tour} cannot compel the Runner to spend one of its hosted virus counters. If the Runner can pay the cost of another mid-access ability, such as the basic trash ability, the Runner must use that ability. If not, the Runner will not be able to trash {card:Mumbad Virtual Tour} at all.
translation: 公司结算了 {card:温迪戈} 上的子进程，使潜袭者在本次潜袭剩余时间内不能使用其已安装的 {card:小恶魔}。之后，潜袭者读取到一张已安装的 {card:孟巴德虚拟之旅}。尽管 {card:孟巴德虚拟之旅} 会强制潜袭者在可能的情况下销毁它，但就 {card:温迪戈} 的禁止而言，{card:小恶魔} 的能力仍然属于可选能力。由于 {card:小恶魔} 的能力在本次潜袭中根本不能被使用，{card:孟巴德虚拟之旅} 便无法迫使潜袭者花费其上的一个病毒指示物。如果潜袭者能够支付另一项读取时能力的费用，例如基础销毁能力，则其必须使用该能力。如果不能，则潜袭者将完全无法销毁 {card:孟巴德虚拟之旅}。

original: 9.5.4. Once a player pays the trigger cost of a paid ability, that ability becomes independent of its source and {ref:rule_abilities_resolution_independent} applies to it.
translation: 一旦玩家支付了一项付费能力的触发费用，该能力便独立于其来源，而{ref:rule_abilities_resolution_independent}适用于它。

original: 9.5.5. If the trigger cost of a paid ability uninstalls or forfeits the source of that paid ability, and the effects of that paid ability refer to or act on cards or counters hosted on that source, set aside any hosted cards and counters as the trigger cost is paid. The set-aside cards or counters are still considered "hosted" for purposes of this ability, but they are not trashed due to not having a host for as long as the ability is resolving. When the ability finishes resolving, if any of those cards or counters are still set aside, they are trashed during {ref:step_checkpoint_hosted_on_agenda} or {ref:step_checkpoint_hosted_on_installed_cards} of the next checkpoint, as appropriate. Other abilities cannot interact with these cards or counters while they are set aside (see {ref:rule_set_aside_zone_passthrough}).
translation: 如果一项付费能力的触发费用会卸载或废除该付费能力的来源，而该付费能力的效果提及或作用于附载在该来源上的卡牌或指示物，则在支付触发费用时，将这些附载卡牌与指示物置于一旁。就该能力而言，这些被置于一旁的卡牌或指示物仍被视为“被附载”，但只要该能力仍在结算，它们便不会因为没有宿主而被销毁。当该能力结算完毕时，如果其中任何卡牌或指示物仍被置于一旁，则它们会在下一次检查点的{ref:step_checkpoint_hosted_on_agenda}或{ref:step_checkpoint_hosted_on_installed_cards}中（依情况适用）被销毁。其他能力在这些卡牌或指示物被置于一旁时不能与之互动（见{ref:rule_set_aside_zone_passthrough}）。

original: The Runner has {card:Fermenter} installed with 4 hosted virus counters. They use its paid ability, which has a cost that includes trashing {card:Fermenter}. As the Runner pays this cost, they set aside the 4 counters. When the ability resolves and refers to the number of hosted virus counters, it includes the counters that were set aside, so the Runner gains 8 credits. When the ability is finished resolving, the counters are returned to the bank.
translation: 潜袭者安装有 {card:发酵罐}，其上附载着 4 枚病毒指示物。其使用该卡牌的付费能力，而该能力的费用包含销毁 {card:发酵罐}。在潜袭者支付此费用时，会将这 4 枚指示物置于一旁。当该能力结算并提及附载病毒指示物的数量时，会将这些被置于一旁的指示物计入，因此潜袭者获得 8 个信用点。当该能力结算完成时，这些指示物会返回银行。

original: The Runner uses the [trash] ability on {card:Street Peddler}. They pay the trigger cost and set the 3 hosted cards aside. When the ability resolves, the Runner installs one of the set-aside cards. Since the other two cards are still set aside, the next checkpoint trashes them just as in any other case of cards that were hosted on a card that is no longer installed. No other abilities are able to tell that the cards were set aside: they are treated as having been installed or trashed from their previous location in the play area.
translation: 潜袭者使用 {card:街头小贩} 的[trash]能力。其支付触发费用，并将附载的 3 张卡牌置于一旁。当该能力结算时，潜袭者安装其中一张被置于一旁的卡牌。由于另外两张卡牌仍被置于一旁，因此下一次检查点会像处理任何附载于一张已不再安装之卡牌上的卡牌一样，将它们销毁。其他能力完全无法察觉这些卡牌曾被置于一旁：它们被视为是从游戏区中原先的位置被安装或被销毁的。

original: This example describes a situation similar to the previous examples, but covers the sequence of steps the game carries out in a higher level of detail. The Corp has priority in a paid ability window, and chooses to trigger the [trash] ability on {card:Reconstruction Contract}. As they pay the trigger cost, moving {card:Reconstruction Contract} to Archives, they set aside the advancement counters hosted on {card:Reconstruction Contract}. Next, a checkpoint occurs following the cost having been paid. After that checkpoint and any corresponding reaction window, the [trash] ability's instruction is ready to become imminent. The Corp chooses a card they can advance to be the instruction's target, and an interrupt window opens. After the interrupt window (assuming the effects of the instruction are not prevented), the Corp moves the set-aside counters to the target card.
translation: 本例描述的情况与前例类似，但会以更高层次的细节说明游戏执行的步骤顺序。公司在一个付费能力窗口中拥有优先权，并选择触发 {card:重建合约} 的[trash]能力。其在支付触发费用时，将 {card:重建合约} 移到档案库，并将附载于其上的推进指示物置于一旁。接着，在费用支付后会发生一次检查点。待该检查点与任何相应的响应窗口结束后，[trash]能力的指示就准备变为即将发生。公司选择一张可以被推进的卡牌，作为该指示的目标，并开启一个打断窗口。在该打断窗口之后（假设该指示的效果未被防止），公司将置于一旁的指示物转移到目标卡牌上。

original: 9.5.6. Paid abilities with certain effects can only be triggered in specific situations.
translation: 具有某些效果的付费能力，只能在特定情境下被触发。

original: 9.5.6.a. A paid ability that contains an instruction that could break 1 or more subroutines can only be used during an encounter.
translation: 包含一条可能会破解 1 条或多条子进程之指示的付费能力，只能在一次遭遇中使用。

original: 9.5.6.b. A paid ability that refers to ice the Runner is approaching can only be used during the Approach Ice Phase of a run, and only if the ice being approached meets all stipulations used in referring to it.
translation: 提及潜袭者正在接驳之防火墙的付费能力，只能在一次潜袭的接驳防火墙阶段中使用，而且仅当正在被接驳的那层防火墙满足该提及中使用的所有规定时才行。

original: The Corp can only use the paid ability on {card:Project Wotan} while the Runner is approaching a rezzed piece of {subtype:bioroid} ice.
translation: 只有在潜袭者正在接驳一层已激活的{subtype:生化人}防火墙时，公司才能使用 {card:奥丁计划} 上的付费能力。

original: 9.5.6.c. A paid ability that refers to ice the Runner is encountering can only be used during an encounter with a piece of ice that meets all stipulations used in referring to it.
translation: 提及潜袭者正在遭遇之防火墙的付费能力，只能在遭遇一层满足该提及中所用全部规定之防火墙时使用。

original: The Runner cannot trigger the first ability on {card:Arruaceiras Crew} at an arbitrary time to give themself a tag. They can only use this ability during an encounter.
translation: 潜袭者不能在任意时点触发 {card:暴力团伙} 上的第一个能力来给予自己锁定标记。其只能在一次遭遇中使用该能力。

original: The Runner can use the [trash] ability on {card:Abagnale} during an encounter with a {subtype:code gate}. They can only use the interface ability on {card:Abagnale} during an encounter with a {subtype:code gate} that {card:Abagnale} has sufficient strength to interface with.
translation: 潜袭者可以在遭遇一层{subtype:门禁}时使用 {card:阿巴内尔} 的[trash]能力。其也只能在遭遇一层{subtype:门禁}，且 {card:阿巴内尔} 具有足够强度可与之对接时，才能使用 {card:阿巴内尔} 的对接能力。

original: 9.5.7. Steps of Using a Paid Ability
translation: 使用一项付费能力的步骤

original: 9.5.7.a. Announce the intent to trigger the paid ability.
translation: 宣告你将触发该付费能力。

original: 9.5.7.b. Pay the trigger cost. The ability and its source are considered used. "When used" abilities meet their trigger conditions. (The cost-paid checkpoint then occurs.)
translation: 支付触发费用。该能力及其来源被视为已使用。“When used”能力满足其触发条件。（随后会发生费用支付后的检查点。）

original: 9.5.7.c. Announce any targets for the ability's first instruction. That instruction then becomes imminent.
translation: 宣告该能力第一条指示的任何目标。随后，该指示变为即将发生。

original: 9.5.7.d. An interrupt window occurs, during which abilities can modify, prevent, or avoid the imminent effects.
translation: 发生一个打断窗口，期间能力可以修改、防止或避免该即将发生的效果。

original: 9.5.7.e. Resolve the instruction, applying any changes to its effects from interrupts that were resolved.
translation: 结算该指示，并应用已结算之打断对其效果作出的任何改变。

original: 9.5.7.f. A checkpoint occurs.
translation: 发生一次检查点。

original: 9.5.7.g. If there are more instructions to resolve, announce any targets for the next instruction. That instruction then becomes imminent. Return to (d).
translation: 如果还有更多指示需要结算，则宣告下一条指示的任何目标。随后，该指示变为即将发生。返回（d）。

original: 9.5.7.h. Resolution of the paid ability is complete.
translation: 该项付费能力的结算完成。

original: 9.6. Conditional Abilities
translation: 条件能力

original: 9.6.1. A {term:conditional ability} is an ability that a player can or must trigger at a specific point in the game. Conditional abilities always include a primary condition and one or more instructions, but they have no special syntax requirements.
translation: {term:条件能力}是玩家在游戏中特定时点可以或必须触发的一种能力。条件能力总是包含一个主要条件与一条或多条指示，但其没有特殊的语法要求。

original: 9.6.1.a. The primary condition of a conditional ability is usually a trigger condition, but can also be a static condition.
translation: 条件能力的主要条件通常是一个触发条件，但也可以是一个静态条件。

original: 9.6.1.b. The primary condition of a conditional ability is often, but not always, written at the front of the ability. See {ref:rule_conditional_abilities_link} for details about conditional ability syntax.
translation: 条件能力的主要条件往往，但不总是，写在该能力的开头。关于条件能力语法的细节，见{ref:rule_conditional_abilities_link}。

original: 9.6.2. When a conditional ability has met its condition, one or more {term:instances} of that conditional ability is created {term:pending} in the next reaction window that opens. Each instance of a conditional ability is a separate copy of that ability that resolves independently of the others. An instance of an ability with the pending status is waiting for its controller to trigger it.
translation: 当一个条件能力满足其条件时，该条件能力的一个或多个{term:实例}会在下一个开启的响应窗口中{term:变为待结算}。条件能力的每个实例，都是该能力的一份单独拷贝，并独立于其他实例结算。具有待结算状态的能力实例正在等待其操控者触发。

original: 9.6.3. A conditional ability with a static condition can only have one instance at a time.
translation: 带有静态条件的条件能力，同一时刻只能具有一个实例。

original: 9.6.4. A conditional ability with a trigger condition can have multiple instances.
translation: 带有触发条件的条件能力，可以具有多个实例。

original: 9.6.4.a. If a trigger condition is met again while an instance of the corresponding ability is already pending, imminent, or resolving, a new instance can still become pending in the next reaction window.
translation: 如果某个触发条件再次满足，而对应能力的一个实例已经处于待结算、即将发生或正在结算状态，则新实例仍然可以在下一个响应窗口中变为待结算。

original: 9.6.4.b. If the trigger condition of an ability is met more than once between consecutive checkpoints, multiple instances of that ability become pending in the next reaction window.
translation: 如果一项能力的触发条件在相邻两次检查点之间满足了不止一次，则该能力的多个实例会在下一个响应窗口中变为待结算。

original: The Runner plays {card:Singularity}, trashing 3 Corp cards simultaneously. Since {card:Hostile Infrastructure}'s trigger condition is met separately for each card trashed, the next checkpoint handles all of those occurrences, and 3 instances of the ability become pending in the same reaction window.
translation: 潜袭者打出 {card:奇点}，同时销毁 3 张公司卡牌。由于 {card:敌意架构} 的触发条件会因每张被销毁的卡牌而分别满足，因此下一次检查点会处理这些发生，从而使该能力的 3 个实例都在同一个响应窗口中变为待结算。

original: The Runner controls {card:Blackguard} and plays {card:Satellite Uplink}, exposing 2 cards in a single instruction. In the next checkpoint, two instances of {card:Blackguard}'s ability become pending, one corresponding to each card that was exposed.
translation: 潜袭者操控 {card:黑暗卫士}，并打出 {card:卫星上行传输}，在一条指示中展示了 2 张卡牌。在下一次检查点中，{card:黑暗卫士} 的能力会有两个实例变为待结算，分别对应每张被展示的卡牌。

original: 9.6.5. The trigger condition of most conditional abilities describes an occurrence that allows it to become pending. These rules about trigger conditions also apply to conditional abilities with static conditions, except as described in {ref:rule_conditional_ability_with_static_condition}.
translation: 大多数条件能力的触发条件会描述一个使其得以变为待结算的事件。这些关于触发条件的规则也适用于带有静态条件的条件能力，除非{ref:rule_conditional_ability_with_static_condition}另有说明。

original: 9.6.5.a. During each checkpoint, the game checks whether any conditional abilities have met their trigger conditions. If any have, a reaction window opens to resolve those abilities (See {ref:sec_checkpoints}). This reaction window is fully resolved and closed before the game proceeds to the next instruction of the original effect or game rule.
translation: 在每次检查点期间，游戏会检查是否有任何条件能力满足了其触发条件。如果有，则会开启一个响应窗口来结算这些能力（见{ref:sec_checkpoints}）。在游戏继续进入原效果或游戏规则的下一条指示之前，该响应窗口会被完全结算并关闭。

original: 9.6.5.b. A conditional ability can only recognize its trigger condition occurring if the ability is active at the time the effect or game state that meets its trigger condition is processed by {ref:step_checkpoint_conditional_abilities} of a checkpoint. If a conditional ability becomes active after its trigger condition was met and a checkpoint has occurred, that ability does not become pending, even if a reaction window associated with that condition is open.
translation: 一项条件能力只有在其于检查点的{ref:step_checkpoint_conditional_abilities}处理满足其触发条件之效果或游戏状态时处于活动状态，才能识别其触发条件发生。如果一项条件能力在其触发条件已满足并且一次检查点已经发生之后才变为活动，则即使与该条件相关联的响应窗口仍然开启，该能力也不会变为待结算。

original: The Corp is resolving their "turn begins" abilities, and they trash {card:Reaper Function} to do 2 net damage. This trashing allows the Corp to use the ability on {card:Ob Superheavy Logistics} to install and rez {card:Nico Campaign}. The Corp cannot take credits from {card:Nico Campaign} this turn because the "turn begins" trigger condition has already been processed.
translation: 公司正在结算其“回合开始时”能力，并销毁 {card:死神函数} 以造成 2 点网域伤害。该次销毁使公司得以使用 {card:鄂毕超重型物流} 上的能力来安装并激活 {card:尼可营销计划}。公司本回合不能从 {card:尼可营销计划} 获得信用点，因为“回合开始时”的触发条件已经被处理过了。

original: The Corp uses {card:Architect Deployment Test} to install and rez a copy of {card:Tranquility Home Grid}, which is the first card installed this turn. After completing the installation from this effect, the Corp pays the rez cost of {card:Tranquility Home Grid}. Since {card:Architect Deployment Test} specified that all costs are ignored, the rez cost is reduced to 0 (see {ref:rule_ignore_all_costs}), but this step still happens and is still followed by a checkpoint (see {ref:rule_cost_checkpoint_cost_zero}). This is the checkpoint that processes that a card was installed, but {card:Tranquility Home Grid} is not yet active and an instance of its ability cannot be created. After the checkpoint and any corresponding reaction window, the Corp finishes rezzing {card:Tranquility Home Grid} and it becomes active.
translation: 公司使用 {card:建筑师部署测试} 来安装并激活一张 {card:宁静家园网阵}，而这是本回合安装的第一张卡牌。在完成该效果的安装后，公司支付 {card:宁静家园网阵} 的激活费用。由于 {card:建筑师部署测试} 指定忽略所有费用，激活费用被减少为 0（见{ref:rule_ignore_all_costs}），但这一步仍然发生，且其后仍会接着发生一次检查点（见{ref:rule_cost_checkpoint_cost_zero}）。这是处理“有卡牌被安装”之事实的检查点，但 {card:宁静家园网阵} 此时尚未活动，其能力的实例不能被创建。在该检查点与任何相应响应窗口之后，公司完成对 {card:宁静家园网阵} 的激活，而它这时才变为活动状态。

original: 9.6.5.c. A conditional ability can only recognize its trigger condition occurring if all the stipulations and requirements listed in the trigger condition are met at the moment that the trigger condition would occur.
translation: 一项条件能力只有在其触发条件所列出的所有规定与要求，都在该触发条件本应发生的时刻得到满足时，才能识别其触发条件发生。

original: The entire trigger condition on {card:Quantum Predictive Model} is "If the Runner is tagged when {card:Quantum Predictive Model} is accessed". {card:Quantum Predictive Model} can only meet its trigger condition if the Runner is tagged at the time the access occurs. Even if {card:Casting Call} is hosted on {card:Quantum Predictive Model}, the tag will be given after the access begins, and no ordering of the abilities will allow {card:Quantum Predictive Model} to meet its trigger condition.
translation: {card:量子预测模型} 上完整的触发条件是：“If the Runner is tagged when {card:量子预测模型} is accessed”。只有在读取发生时潜袭者已经被锁定，{card:量子预测模型} 才能满足其触发条件。即使 {card:试镜选角} 附载在 {card:量子预测模型} 上，锁定标记也会在读取开始后才给予，因此无论能力如何排序，都无法让 {card:量子预测模型} 满足其触发条件。

original: 9.6.5.d. Additional stipulations and requirements listed in the instructions of a conditional ability are checked as part of the ability's effects and are not part of the ability's trigger condition. For the effects under the scope of this kind of condition to resolve, the condition only needs to be met when the relevant instructions resolve. This can occur even if some or all of those conditions were not met at the time the ability met its trigger condition.
translation: 列在条件能力指示中的额外规定与要求，会作为该能力效果的一部分来检查，而不构成该能力触发条件的一部分。对于受此类条件约束的效果部分来说，该条件只需在相关指示结算时满足即可。即使其中某些或全部条件在该能力满足其触发条件时并未满足，这种情况仍然可能发生。

original: If a Runner with 1 link has both {card:Underworld Contact} installed and {card:The Supplier} installed hosting a {card:Dyson Mem Chip}, both {card:Underworld Contact} and {card:The Supplier} meet their trigger conditions at the same time. The Runner can trigger {card:The Supplier} first, installing the Dyson Mem Chip, thus allowing {card:Underworld Contact} to recognize that the Runner has 2 link and give them 1 credit, even though the Runner did not have 2 link at the time the {card:Underworld Contact} became pending.
translation: 如果一位拥有1点中转的潜袭者同时安装了{card:秘密接触}与附载着一张{card:戴森内存芯片}的{card:供应商}，那么{card:秘密接触}与{card:供应商}会同时满足其触发条件。潜袭者可以先触发{card:供应商}，安装这张{card:戴森内存芯片}，从而使{card:秘密接触}识别到潜袭者拥有2点中转并给予其1点信用点，尽管在{card:秘密接触}变为待结算时，潜袭者尚未拥有2点中转。

original: 9.6.5.e. The phrase "If successful" in reference to a run is a trigger condition with specific rules. See {ref:rule_if_successful}. The phrases "If successful" and "If unsuccessful" are also frequently used as trigger conditions relating to the results of a trace. See {ref:sec_traces}.
translation: 与潜袭相关的“If successful”一语，是一个具有特殊规则的触发条件。见{ref:rule_if_successful}。“If successful”与“If unsuccessful”也经常被用作与追踪结果有关的触发条件。见{ref:sec_traces}。

original: 9.6.6. Trigger conditions look for an instantaneous change in the game state. The next checkpoint after that change takes place marks an instance of the ability as pending for each occurrence of the change that was looked for.
translation: 触发条件会寻找游戏状态中的瞬时变化。在该变化发生后的下一次检查点中，会为每一次所寻找之变化的发生，将该能力的一个实例标记为待结算。

original: 9.6.6.a. Some conditional abilities refer to the game state before the trigger condition was met, using the word "had". The previous game state referred to is the game state at the time of {ref:step_checkpoint_conditional_abilities} of the checkpoint immediately preceding the checkpoint in which the ability became pending.
translation: 某些条件能力会使用“had”一词，提及在其触发条件得到满足之前的游戏状态。这里所提及的先前游戏状态，是指该能力变为待结算之检查点前一个检查点的{ref:step_checkpoint_conditional_abilities}时刻的游戏状态。

original: The ability of {card:Weyland Consortium: Built to Last} only causes the Corp to gain 2[c] when they advance a card that "had no advancement counters". This ability becomes pending immediately after an instruction resolves in which the Corp advances a card, and the requirement is checked against the state of the game at the previous checkpoint, before that advancement took place.
translation: {card:威兰财团：建造不朽} 的能力只会在公司推进一张“had no advancement counters”的卡牌时，让公司获得 2[c]。该能力会在公司推进一张卡牌之指示结算后立即变为待结算，而其中的要求会对照前一次检查点中的游戏状态来检查，也就是在那次推进发生之前。

original: 9.6.7. Conditional abilities with a static condition instead of a trigger condition describe an effect that must be performed repeatedly, if possible, while the condition is true. Such abilities usually attempt to end their own repetition by uninstalling their source.
translation: 带有静态条件而非触发条件的条件能力，描述的是一种只要条件为真、就必须反复执行的效果（如果可能的话）。这类能力通常会尝试通过卸载其来源来结束自己的重复。

original: 9.6.7.a. During each checkpoint, the game checks whether any conditional abilities with static conditions should become pending, alongside conditional abilities with trigger conditions. However, there are further requirements for this kind of ability to be marked pending.
translation: 在每次检查点期间，游戏会像检查带有触发条件的条件能力一样，检查带有静态条件的条件能力是否应变为待结算。然而，这类能力要被标记为待结算，还必须满足进一步的要求。

original: 9.6.7.b. A conditional ability with a static condition can only be marked pending during a checkpoint if the condition is true at the beginning of that checkpoint.
translation: 带有静态条件的条件能力，只有在该条件于该检查点开始时为真，才能在该检查点期间被标记为待结算。

original: 9.6.7.c. A conditional ability with a static condition can only be marked pending if no other instance of the same ability from the same source is already pending, imminent, or resolving.
translation: 带有静态条件的条件能力，只有在同一来源的相同能力没有其他实例已处于待结算、即将发生或正在结算状态时，才能被标记为待结算。

original: 9.6.7.d. If a conditional ability with a static condition resolves and no instruction in that ability had any expected effects at the time that instruction's interrupt window opened, that ability cannot be marked pending again until a timing structure step is completed.
translation: 如果一项带有静态条件的条件能力结算时，在其任何指示的打断窗口开启时，该能力中的任何指示都没有任何预期效果，那么在一个时序步骤完成之前，该能力不能再次被标记为待结算。

original: {card:Parasite} is hosted on a piece of ice with 0 strength. {card:Parasite}'s ability tries to trash that ice. If the effect of an interrupt ability prevents the ice from being trashed without increasing its strength, the condition is still true, so the ability will become pending again. But this does not occur while the previous instance of the ability is still pending or resolving. Conversely, if a static ability (such as the one on {card:Architect}) prohibits {card:Parasite} from trashing the ice, there are no effects {card:Parasite}'s ability can perform, and therefore the ability resolves only once per timing structure step.
translation: {card:寄生虫} 附载在一层强度为 0 的防火墙上。{card:寄生虫} 的能力试图销毁该层防火墙。如果某个打断能力的效果在不提高其强度的情况下防止了该防火墙被销毁，则条件仍然为真，因此该能力会再次变为待结算。但这不会发生在该能力先前实例仍处于待结算或正在结算状态时。相反，如果某项持续能力（例如 {card:建筑师} 上的那项）禁止 {card:寄生虫} 销毁该层防火墙，那么 {card:寄生虫} 的能力就没有任何可执行的效果，因此它在每个时序步骤中只会结算一次。

original: 9.6.8. A player can trigger a conditional ability while they have priority in a reaction window in which the ability is pending.
translation: 玩家可以在自己拥有优先权的响应窗口中触发一项处于待结算状态的条件能力。

original: 9.6.8.a. Once a player triggers a conditional ability, that instance of the ability loses its pending status. Other pending instances of the ability are unaffected and can still be triggered later, regardless of whether those instances are associated with the same reaction window.
translation: 一旦玩家触发了一项条件能力，该能力的那个实例就会失去待结算状态。其他待结算实例不受影响，无论它们是否与同一个响应窗口相关联，都仍然可以稍后被触发。

original: 9.6.8.b. If the [interrupt] symbol appears before a conditional ability's text, that ability is an interrupt. These abilities will become pending in interrupt windows rather than reaction windows, but are otherwise resolved in the same way as non-interrupt conditional abilities. See {ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}.
translation: 如果[interrupt]符号出现在一项条件能力文本之前，则该能力是一项打断。这些能力会在打断窗口而非响应窗口中变为待结算，但除此之外，其结算方式与非打断的条件能力相同。见{ref:sec_interrupts_replacements}。

original: 9.6.9. If a conditional ability gives its controller a choice of whether to apply its effects, such that the ability could potentially have no effects at all, it is considered an {term:optional conditional ability}. These abilities can usually be recognized by the presence of permissive words such as "may" or "allows", or by a restriction such as "Use this ability only once per turn." If the ability is not optional, then it is a {term:mandatory conditional ability}.
translation: 如果一项条件能力给予其操控者一个是否适用其效果的选择，以至于该能力有可能完全没有任何效果，则其被视为一项{term:可选条件能力}。这类能力通常可以通过诸如“may”或“allows”这样的许可性词语，或通过类似“Use this ability only once per turn.”这样的限制来识别。如果该能力不是可选的，则它就是一项{term:强制条件能力}。

original: 9.6.9.a. Instances of optional conditional abilities can still be pending when their controller passes in the corresponding priority window. Players are not required to trigger optional conditional abilities.
translation: 可选条件能力的实例，在其操控者于对应优先权窗口中让过时，仍然可以处于待结算状态。玩家没有义务触发可选条件能力。

original: 9.6.9.b. Players must trigger all instances of pending mandatory conditional abilities they control in a given priority window before they can pass in that window. See {ref:rule_reaction_window}.
translation: 玩家必须先触发其在某个给定优先权窗口中操控的所有待结算强制条件能力实例，然后才能在该窗口中让过。见{ref:rule_reaction_window}。

original: 9.6.9.c. Both optional and mandatory conditional abilities may have optional parts to their effects. Even if triggering the ability is mandatory, its controller may still decline any optional constituent effects that arise during its resolution.
translation: 可选与强制条件能力都可能在其效果中包含可选部分。即使触发该能力是强制的，其操控者在其结算期间仍然可以拒绝任何出现的可选组成效果。

original: 9.6.9.d. A conditional ability and its source are considered used when any optional component of the ability's effects is carried out.
translation: 一项条件能力及其来源，会在该能力效果中的任何可选组成部分被执行时，被视为已使用。

original: 9.6.10. If any instances of a conditional ability are pending and the conditional ability itself becomes inactive, those instances lose their pending status and will not resolve.
translation: 如果某项条件能力有任何实例处于待结算状态，而该条件能力本身变为闲置状态，则这些实例会失去待结算状态，且不会结算。

original: The Runner has both {card:Aesop's Pawnshop} and {card:Drug Dealer} installed. Both cards have abilities that meet their trigger conditions when the Runner's turn begins. If the Runner chooses to trigger {card:Aesop's Pawnshop} first, and then uses it to trash {card:Drug Dealer}, {card:Drug Dealer}'s pending ability can never be triggered, so the Runner does not lose a credit.
translation: 潜袭者同时安装有 {card:伊索的典当铺} 与 {card:毒贩}。这两张卡牌都具有会在潜袭者回合开始时满足触发条件的能力。如果潜袭者选择先触发 {card:伊索的典当铺}，然后用它销毁 {card:毒贩}，则 {card:毒贩} 待结算中的能力便永远无法被触发，因此潜袭者不会失去 1 个信用点。

original: 9.6.11. If a priority window closes while any abilities still have pending instances associated with that window, the remaining instances lose their pending status and cannot be triggered or resolved. See {ref:rule_reaction_window_closing_timing_structure}.
translation: 如果某个优先权窗口关闭时，仍有任何能力的待结算实例与该窗口相关联，则这些剩余实例会失去待结算状态，并不能被触发或结算。见{ref:rule_reaction_window_closing_timing_structure}。

original: 9.6.12. Once a player triggers a conditional ability and its instructions become imminent, the ability becomes independent of its source and {ref:rule_abilities_resolution_independent} applies to it.
translation: 一旦玩家触发了一项条件能力，且其指示变为即将发生，该能力便独立于其来源，而{ref:rule_abilities_resolution_independent}适用于它。

original: 9.6.13. A {term:delayed conditional ability} is a conditional ability maintained by a lingering effect (see {ref:sec_lingering_effects}). Unlike other lingering effects, some delayed conditional abilities are created without an explicitly stated duration.
translation: {term:延时条件能力}是一项由残留效果维持的条件能力（见{ref:sec_lingering_effects}）。不同于其他残留效果，有些延时条件能力的创建并未明确写出持续时间。

original: 9.6.13.a. If an "if successful" ability contains a nested delayed conditional ability referring to breaching the attacked server, that ability applies to the breach at {ref:step_breach} of the run the "if successful" ability is associated with. Its duration expires at the end of the run. See {ref:rule_if_successful_lingering_effect}.
translation: 如果一项“If successful”能力包含一个提及侵入被攻击服务器的嵌套延时条件能力，则该能力会适用于与该“If successful”能力相关的那次潜袭，在其{ref:step_breach}处发生的侵入。其持续时间会在该次潜袭结束时失效。见{ref:rule_if_successful_lingering_effect}。

original: 9.6.13.b. If an instruction creates a delayed conditional ability and specifies a duration, the delayed conditional ability is active until that duration expires.
translation: 如果一条指示创造了一项延时条件能力，并明确指定了持续时间，则该延时条件能力会一直活动，直到该持续时间失效为止。

original: {card:In the Groove} creates a delayed conditional ability that specifies a duration of "this turn". Since a duration is specified, it is not limited to only being triggered once. The ability becomes pending and can resolve every time its trigger condition is met, and its existence only expires at the end of the turn.
translation: {card:最佳状态} 会创造一个持续时间为“本回合”的延时条件能力。由于指定了持续时间，它并不只限于被触发一次。每当其触发条件满足时，该能力都会变为待结算并可以结算，而其存在只会在回合结束时失效。

original: 9.6.13.c. Any other delayed conditional ability exists until the next time it resolves, after which it expires.
translation: 任何其他延时条件能力会一直存在，直到其下一次结算；结算后便失效。

original: {card:Joshua B.}'s ability allows the Runner to gain [click]. If they do, it creates a delayed conditional ability that is independent of {card:Joshua B.} itself, which will meet its trigger condition only once, when that turn ends. After that ability resolves, the game no longer maintains the lingering effect creating the ability.
translation: {card:约书亚B.} 的能力允许潜袭者获得[click]。如果其如此做，就会创造一个独立于 {card:约书亚B.} 本身的延时条件能力，该能力的触发条件只会满足一次，即在该回合结束时。在该能力结算之后，游戏便不再维持创造该能力的残留效果。
