original: 9.6.13.d. If an effect tries to create a delayed conditional ability with the trigger condition "When this run ends", but there is no run in progress, then the lingering effect is not created.
translation: 如果某个效果试图创造一个触发条件为“When this run ends”的延时条件能力，但当前并没有潜袭进行中，则该残留效果不会被创建。

original: The Runner encounters a piece of ice outside of a run, and uses {card:Mayfly} to break its subroutines. Since there is no run in progress, the delayed conditional ability inside {card:Mayfly}'s interface ability cannot be created, and {card:Mayfly} will not be trashed.
translation: 潜袭者在潜袭之外遭遇一层防火墙，并使用 {card:蜉蝣} 破解其子进程。由于当前没有潜袭进行中，{card:蜉蝣} 对接能力中的延时条件能力无法被创建，而 {card:蜉蝣} 也不会被销毁。

original: 9.6.14. Some cards refer to a class of conditional abilities according to their trigger condition.
translation: 某些卡牌会按照触发条件来指代某一类条件能力。

original: 9.6.14.a. A "when encountered" ability is any ability that could meet its trigger condition at {ref:step_encounter_begins} of an encounter with its source.
translation: “when encountered”能力，是任何会在遭遇其来源的{ref:step_encounter_begins}满足其触发条件的能力。

original: 9.6.14.b. A "when installed" ability is any ability that could meet its trigger condition at {ref:rule_steps_installing_installed_condition} of the process of installing its source.
translation: “when installed”能力，是任何会在安装其来源流程中的{ref:rule_steps_installing_installed_condition}满足其触发条件的能力。

original: 9.6.14.c. A "when scored" ability is any ability on an agenda that could meet its trigger condition as a result of the Corp choosing the option to score that agenda during a paid ability window (see {ref:rule_paid_ability_window_corp_score}).
translation: “when scored”能力，是任何议案上的能力，只要该能力可能由于公司在一个付费能力窗口中选择计分该议案（见{ref:rule_paid_ability_window_corp_score}）而满足其触发条件。

original: 9.6.14.d. If an effect attempts to resolve a conditional ability according to one of the classes identified in {ref:rule_references_to_trigger_conditions}, the ability is marked pending as though the stipulation of that class had occurred. Any additional requirements of the trigger condition in question must still be met by the game state.
translation: 如果某个效果试图按照{ref:rule_references_to_trigger_conditions}中识别出的某一类别来结算一项条件能力，则该能力会被标记为待结算，如同该类别所规定的情况已经发生了一样。该触发条件中的任何额外要求，仍然必须由当前游戏状态满足。

original: The Corp has scored {card:AstroScript Pilot Program} and {card:Market Research}. They forfeit one of those agendas to play {card:24/7 News Cycle} and resolve the "when scored" ability of the other agenda, even though neither agenda was actually scored at this time. The Corp can forfeit {card:Market Research} to resolve {card:AstroScript Pilot Program}'s ability and put an agenda counter on it, with no other stipulations. If the Runner is tagged, the Corp could instead forfeit {card:AstroScript Pilot Program} to put an agenda counter on {card:Market Research}. However, if the Runner is not tagged, the additional requirement of {card:Market Research}'s trigger condition will not be met, so its "when scored" ability cannot become pending or resolve.
translation: 公司已经计分了 {card:神符实验项目} 与 {card:市场研究}。其废除其中一张议案来打出 {card:24/7新闻循环}，并结算另一张议案的“when scored”能力，尽管这两张议案此时实际上都没有被计分。公司可以废除 {card:市场研究} 来结算 {card:神符实验项目} 的能力，并在其上放置一个议案指示物，而无其他额外规定。如果潜袭者已被锁定，则公司也可以改为废除 {card:神符实验项目}，以在 {card:市场研究} 上放置一个议案指示物。然而，如果潜袭者未被锁定，则 {card:市场研究} 触发条件中的额外要求不会满足，因此其“when scored”能力不能变为待结算或结算。

original: 9.6.15. Steps of Triggering and Resolving a Conditional Ability
translation: 触发并结算一项条件能力的步骤

original: 9.6.15.a. Announce that you will trigger one of the pending abilities associated with the reaction window that gave you priority.
translation: 宣告你将触发一个与给予你优先权之响应窗口相关联的待结算能力。

original: 9.6.15.b. Announce any targets for the ability's first instruction. That instruction then becomes imminent.
translation: 宣告该能力第一条指示的任何目标。随后，该指示变为即将发生。

original: 9.6.15.c. An interrupt window occurs, during which abilities can modify, prevent, or avoid the imminent effects.
translation: 发生一个打断窗口，期间能力可以修改、防止或避免该即将发生的效果。

original: 9.6.15.d. Resolve the instruction, applying any changes to its effects from interrupts that were resolved. If the controller of the ability chooses to resolve an optional effect contained in this instruction, and this is the first instruction for which that player has done so, "when used" conditionals meet their trigger conditions.
translation: 结算该指示，并应用已结算之打断对其效果作出的任何改变。如果该能力的操控者选择结算包含在这条指示中的可选效果，且这是该玩家第一次如此做的指示，则“when used”条件能力满足其触发条件。

original: 9.6.15.e. A checkpoint occurs.
translation: 发生一次检查点。

original: 9.6.15.f. If there are more instructions to resolve, announce any targets for the next instruction. That instruction then becomes imminent. Return to (c).
translation: 如果还有更多指示需要结算，则宣告下一条指示的任何目标。随后，该指示变为即将发生。返回（c）。

original: 9.6.15.g. Resolution of the conditional ability is complete.
translation: 该项条件能力的结算完成。

original: 9.7. Play Abilities
translation: 打出能力

original: 9.7.1. Any ability on an event or operation that is not a paid, conditional, or static ability is a {term:play ability}. Play abilities are the abilities that resolve as part of playing that event or operation during {ref:rule_steps_playing_resolve_play_abilities}.
translation: 事件牌或事务上的任何能力，只要它不是付费能力、条件能力或持续能力，就是一种{term:打出能力}。打出能力是在{ref:rule_steps_playing_resolve_play_abilities}中，作为打出该事件牌或事务的一部分而结算的能力。

original: The operation card {card:Oppo Research} has several abilities of different types. The first ability reads "Play only if the Runner stole or trashed a Corp card during their last turn." This is a static ability that contains a restriction and no declarations. The second ability ("After you resolve this operation, your action phase ends.") is a conditional ability that meets its trigger condition and resolves after the Corp finishes playing and resolving {card:Oppo Research}. The third and fourth abilities contain instructions with no trigger conditions or paid ability trigger costs, so they are both play abilities. They resolve in sequence while {card:Oppo Research} is being played.
translation: 事务{card:竞对调研}具有数个不同类型的能力。第一个能力写着“只有在潜袭者于其上一回合窃取或销毁过一张公司卡牌时才能打出。”这是一个包含限制且不包含声明的持续能力。第二个能力（“在你结算完此事务后，你的行动阶段结束。”）是一个条件能力；在公司完成打出并结算{card:竞对调研}后，它满足触发条件并进行结算。第三和第四个能力都包含指示，且不具有触发条件或付费能力的触发费用，因此它们都是打出能力。它们会在打出{card:竞对调研}的过程中按顺序结算。

original: 9.7.2. Steps of Resolving a Play Ability
translation: 打出能力的结算步骤

original: 9.7.2.a. Announce any targets for the ability's first instruction. That instruction then becomes imminent.
translation: 为该能力的第一条指示宣告所有目标。然后该指示变为即将发生。

original: 9.7.2.b. An interrupt window occurs, during which abilities can modify, prevent, or avoid the imminent effects.
translation: 开启一个打断窗口，此时能力可以修改、防止或避免该即将发生的效果。

original: 9.7.2.c. Resolve the instruction, applying any changes to its effects from interrupts that were resolved.
translation: 结算该指示，并应用已结算之打断对其效果作出的任何改变。

original: 9.7.2.d. A checkpoint occurs.
translation: 进行一次检查点。

original: 9.7.2.e. If there are more instructions to resolve, announce any targets for the next instruction. That instruction then becomes imminent. Return to (b).
translation: 如果还有更多指示需要结算，则为下一条指示宣告所有目标。然后该指示变为即将发生。返回(b)。

original: 9.7.2.f. Resolution of the play ability is complete.
translation: 该打出能力结算完毕。

original: 9.8. Subroutines
translation: 子程序

original: 9.8.1. A {term:subroutine} is an ability beginning with the [sub] symbol. Only ice can have subroutines.
translation: 子程序是一种以[sub]符号开头的能力。只有防火墙可以具有子程序。

original: 9.8.2. Subroutines always have a specified order. {n}Subroutines on a piece of ice are categorized based on how the ice gained them, as described in {ref:rule_subroutine_origins}. All subroutines in the first category presented ({ref:rule_subroutine_origin_external_before}) are ordered first, followed by all subroutines in the second category ({ref:rule_subroutine_origin_static_before}), and so on. Each category's description includes the rule for how multiple subroutines within that category are ordered.{/n}
translation: 子程序总是具有明确顺序。{n}如{ref:rule_subroutine_origins}所述，一张防火墙上的子程序会根据该防火墙如何获得这些子程序而分为不同类别。首先排列最先列出的类别中的全部子程序（{ref:rule_subroutine_origin_external_before}），然后是第二类中的全部子程序（{ref:rule_subroutine_origin_static_before}），依此类推。每个类别的说明都包含该类别内多个子程序如何排序的规则。{/n}

original: 9.8.2.a. One card, {card:TL;DR}, has an ability which can grant a second copy of each subroutine on a piece of ice. Each subroutine created this way is ordered immediately after the subroutine it copied, regardless of categories. If any subroutines are removed while the copies are still active, the copies remain in their relative order as if the removed subroutines were still present.
translation: 有一张卡牌{card:太长；不看}具有一个能力，可以使一张防火墙上的每个子程序各获得一个第二份副本。以此方式创建的每个子程序都紧接在其复制的子程序之后进行排序，而不考虑类别。如果在这些副本仍然生效时有任何子程序被移除，则这些副本仍保持其相对顺序，就仿佛被移除的子程序仍然存在一样。

original: 9.8.2.b. One card, {card:Hive}, has a static ability that removes its own printed subroutines. Subroutines are lost to this ability beginning with the last printed subroutine and working backwards.
translation: 有一张卡牌{card:蜂巢}具有一个持续能力，会移除其自身印刷的子程序。由于该能力而失去的子程序，会从最后一个印刷子程序开始，逆序移除。

original: 9.8.2.c. Some Corp abilities grant 1 or more subroutines "in the order of your choice". When such an ability resolves, the Corp declares the order of each subroutine added by the ability relative to each other subroutine the ice has at that time, regardless of categories.
translation: 某些公司的能力会“按你选择的顺序”为一张防火墙赋予1个或更多子程序。当此类能力结算时，公司须声明由该能力添加的每个子程序，相对于该防火墙当时具有的其他每个子程序的位置，而不考虑类别。

original: The Runner encounters a copy of {card:Lancelot} hosting a condition counter from {card:Sub Boost}. The Corp reveals a copy of {card:Merlin} in HQ to add a "[sub] Do 2 net damage." subroutine to {card:Lancelot}. The Corp declares whether the subroutine from {card:Merlin} will be added before {card:Lancelot}'s printed "[sub] Trash 1 installed program." subroutine, between the printed subroutine and the "[sub] End the run." subroutine granted by the condition counter, or after the "[sub] End the run." subroutine.
translation: 潜袭者正在遭遇一张附载着来自{card:子进程助推}状态指示物的{card:兰斯洛特}。公司展示总部中的一张{card:梅林}，以向{card:兰斯洛特}添加一个“[sub]造成2点网络伤害。”子程序。公司声明该子程序是添加在{card:兰斯洛特}印刷的“[sub]销毁1个已安装的程序。”子程序之前、位于该印刷子程序与由状态指示物赋予的“[sub]终止本次潜袭。”子程序之间，还是添加在“[sub]终止本次潜袭。”子程序之后。

original: 9.8.2.d. If multiple subroutines are added to a piece of ice {n}by the same category of effect{/n} at the same time in an unspecified order, the Corp declares the relative order of those subroutines at the time the ice gains them.
translation: 如果1个以上子程序由于{n}同一类别的效果{/n}在同一时间以未指定顺序被加入一张防火墙，则当该防火墙获得它们时，公司须声明这些子程序彼此之间的相对顺序。

original: 9.8.3. The categories of subroutines used to determine their order, as described in {ref:rule_subroutines_ordered}, are as follows:
translation: 如{ref:rule_subroutines_ordered}所述，用于确定子程序顺序的各类别如下：

original: 9.8.3.a. Subroutines gained from an ability, except a static ability on the ice itself, where the ability granting the subroutines states they are added before other subroutines. Subroutines within this category are ordered based on when the effect granting them began to apply, with the most recently added subroutines first.
translation: 来自某个能力（防火墙自身上的持续能力除外）的子程序，且该能力说明这些子程序会添加在其他子程序之前。此类别中的子程序按照赋予它们的效果开始适用的时间排序，最近加入的子程序排在最前。

original: The Runner encounters a copy of {card:Loki} while {card:Stick and Poke} is installed and {card:Warden Fatuma} is rezzed. Since {card:Warden Fatuma}'s ability is a static ability, the subroutine it grants is already present when the encounter begins. The Runner resolves the ability from {card:Stick and Poke}, then the Corp resolves the ability from {card:Loki}, choosing a copy of {card:Tithe}. The subroutines on {card:Loki} are, in order: "[sub] Do 1 net damage.", "[sub] Gain 1[c].", "[sub] Do 1 net damage. The Runner draws 1 card.", "[sub] The Runner loses [click].", and "[sub] End the run unless the Runner shuffles all cards from the grip into the stack."
translation: 潜袭者正在遭遇{card:洛基}，且{card:针仔与戳仔}已安装、{card:监察员法图玛}已激活。由于{card:监察员法图玛}的能力是一项持续能力，它赋予的子程序在遭遇开始时就已经存在。潜袭者先结算{card:针仔与戳仔}的能力，然后公司结算{card:洛基}的能力，选择一张{card:什一税}。此时{card:洛基}上的子程序依顺序为：“[sub]造成1点网络伤害。”、“[sub]获得1[c]。”、“[sub]造成1点网络伤害。潜袭者抽1张牌。”、“[sub]潜袭者失去[click]。”以及“[sub]除非潜袭者将其手牌中的所有卡牌洗回牌库，否则终止本次潜袭。”

original: 9.8.3.b. Subroutines gained from a static ability on the ice itself, where the ability states the subroutines are added before other subroutines. Subroutines in this category on a single piece of ice are always identical. If the number of such subroutines increases, the new copies are added after any previously-existing subroutines in this category. If the number of such subroutines decreases, subroutines are lost beginning with the last subroutine the ice previously had from the same ability and working backwards.
translation: 来自防火墙自身上某个持续能力的子程序，且该能力说明这些子程序会添加在其他子程序之前。单张防火墙上此类别中的子程序总是彼此相同。如果此类子程序的数量增加，则新加入的副本会添加在此类别中先前已有的任何子程序之后。如果此类子程序的数量减少，则失去子程序时会从该防火墙先前因同一能力获得的最后一个子程序开始，逆序移除。

original: 9.8.3.c. Subroutines printed on the ice. Subroutines this category are ordered in the same way as they are written in the ice's card text.
translation: 印刷在该防火墙上的子程序。此类别中的子程序按照其在防火墙卡牌文字上书写的顺序进行排序。

original: 9.8.3.d. Subroutines gained from a static ability on the ice itself, where the ability either states the subroutines are added after other subroutines or does not specify an order. Subroutines in this category on a single piece of ice are always identical. If the number of such subroutines increases, the new copies are added after any previously-existing subroutines in this category. If the number of such subroutines decreases, subroutines are lost beginning with the last subroutine the ice previously had from the same ability and working backwards.
translation: 来自防火墙自身上某个持续能力的子程序，且该能力要么说明这些子程序会添加在其他子程序之后，要么未指定顺序。单张防火墙上此类别中的子程序总是彼此相同。如果此类子程序的数量增加，则新加入的副本会添加在此类别中先前已有的任何子程序之后。如果此类子程序的数量减少，则失去子程序时会从该防火墙先前因同一能力获得的最后一个子程序开始，逆序移除。

original: The Corp has 3 cards in HQ while the Runner is encountering {card:Ashigaru}. After the Runner breaks {card:Ashigaru}'s 3 subroutines, the Corp uses {card:Panic Button} to draw another card. The new subroutine is added after the previous 3, so the Runner can use {card:Gbahali} to break it.
translation: 公司手牌区有3张牌，潜袭者正在遭遇{card:足轻}。潜袭者破解了{card:足轻}的3个子程序后，公司使用{card:应急按钮}抽1张牌。新子程序会添加在原先3个子程序之后，因此潜袭者可以用{card:巴哈利}来破解它。

original: The Corp has 3 cards in HQ while the Runner is encountering {card:Ashigaru}. The Runner breaks the first subroutine, then uses {card:Utopia Shard} to force the Corp to discard 2 cards. {card:Ashigaru} correspondingly loses its last 2 subroutines, leaving behind the subroutine that was already broken.
translation: 公司手牌区有3张牌，潜袭者正在遭遇{card:足轻}。潜袭者破解了第一个子程序，然后使用{card:乌托邦碎片}迫使公司弃置2张牌。{card:足轻}因而失去其最后2个子程序，留下的是那个已经被破解的子程序。

original: 9.8.3.e. Subroutines gained from an ability, except a static ability on the ice itself, where the ability either states the subroutines are added after other subroutines or does not specify an order. Subroutines within this category are ordered based on when the effect granting them began to apply, with the oldest subroutines first.
translation: 来自某个能力（防火墙自身上的持续能力除外）的子程序，且该能力要么说明这些子程序会添加在其他子程序之后，要么未指定顺序。此类别中的子程序按照赋予它们的效果开始适用的时间排序，最早加入的子程序排在最前。

original: The Runner encounters {card:Marker}, and its subroutine resolves. The next ice the Runner encounters is {card:Brainstorm}. When the encounter begins, the lingering effect from {card:Marker} gives {card:Brainstorm} an "[sub] End the run." subroutine. Then, {card:Brainstorm}'s conditional ability resolves, giving it the appropriate number of "[sub] Do 1 core damage." subroutines. The "[sub] Do 1 core damage." subroutines are all ordered after the "[sub] End the run." subroutine.
translation: 潜袭者遭遇{card:标记}，其子程序结算。潜袭者接下来遭遇的防火墙是{card:头脑风暴}。当遭遇开始时，来自{card:标记}的残留效果会赋予{card:头脑风暴}一个“[sub]终止本次潜袭。”子程序。然后，{card:头脑风暴}的条件能力结算，赋予其数量适当的“[sub]造成1点核心伤害。”子程序。所有“[sub]造成1点核心伤害。”子程序都排在“[sub]终止本次潜袭。”子程序之后。

original: 9.8.4. For each encounter, the subroutines on the encountered ice have a status of {term:broken} or {term:unbroken} with respect to that encounter.
translation: 对于每次遭遇，所遭遇防火墙上的子程序就该次遭遇而言都具有{term:已破解}或{term:未破解}状态。

original: 9.8.4.a. When an encounter begins, each of the encountered ice's subroutines becomes unbroken with respect to that encounter.
translation: 当一次遭遇开始时，所遭遇防火墙上的每个子程序就该次遭遇而言都变为未破解。

original: 9.8.4.b. When a piece of ice gains 1 or more new subroutines during an encounter with it, those subroutines come into existence unbroken with respect to that encounter.
translation: 当一张防火墙在与其遭遇期间获得1个或更多新的子程序时，这些子程序在该次遭遇中产生时均为未破解状态。

original: 9.8.4.c. When an encounter ends, card abilities can still check whether subroutines were broken or unbroken during that encounter.
translation: 当一次遭遇结束时，卡牌能力仍可检查在该次遭遇期间子程序是已破解还是未破解。

original: 9.8.5. To {term:break} a subroutine is to change its status with respect to the active encounter from unbroken to broken. Many cards that can allow a player to break subroutines are icebreakers (see {ref:subsec_icebreakers}). If the Runner breaks all the subroutines on the encountered ice, they fully break that ice (see {ref:subsec_fully_break}).
translation: 要{term:破解}一个子程序，就是将其相对于当前遭遇的状态从未破解改为已破解。许多能够让玩家破解子程序的卡牌都是破解器（见{ref:subsec_icebreakers}）。如果潜袭者破解了所遭遇防火墙上的全部子程序，则其完全破解该防火墙（见{ref:subsec_fully_break}）。

original: 9.8.6. Only unbroken subroutines can be chosen as targets for abilities that would break them.
translation: 只有未破解的子程序才能被选作那些会破解它们之能力的目标。

original: 9.8.6.a. An ability that breaks "all subroutines" does not target any subroutines, and can be used as long as the encountered ice has at least 1 unbroken subroutine.
translation: 以“破解所有子程序”表述的能力不以任何子程序为目标，并且只要所遭遇的防火墙上至少有1个未破解子程序即可使用。

original: 9.8.6.b. One card, {card:Grappling Hook}, has the ability to break "all but 1 subroutine" on the encountered ice. To trigger this ability, its controller chooses as its target the 1 subroutine that will not be broken. When the ability resolves, it breaks all unbroken subroutines except the chosen subroutine.
translation: 有一张卡牌{card:爪钩}具有破解所遭遇防火墙上“除1个以外所有子程序”的能力。要触发该能力，其操控者须选择那1个不会被破解的子程序作为目标。当该能力结算时，它会破解除所选子程序外的所有未破解子程序。

original: The Runner uses two copies of {card:Grappling Hook} to break all of the subroutines on {card:Heimdall 1.0}. For the first {card:Grappling Hook}, the Runner chooses the unbroken "[sub] Do 1 core damage." subroutine as the target, and {card:Grappling Hook} breaks both "[sub] End the run." subroutines. For the second {card:Grappling Hook}, the Runner chooses one of the already-broken "[sub] End the run." subroutines as the target. They can choose the broken subroutine as {card:Grappling Hook}'s target because {card:Grappling Hook} will not attempt to break the chosen subroutine. When the ability resolves, {card:Grappling Hook} breaks the "[sub] Do 1 core damage." subroutine, but does nothing to the other "[sub] End the run." subroutine, because it is already broken.
translation: 潜袭者使用两张{card:爪钩}来破解{card:海姆达尔1.0}上的全部子程序。对于第一张{card:爪钩}，潜袭者选择未破解的“[sub]造成1点核心伤害。”子程序作为目标，而{card:爪钩}会破解两个“[sub]终止本次潜袭。”子程序。对于第二张{card:爪钩}，潜袭者选择其中一个已经被破解的“[sub]终止本次潜袭。”子程序作为目标。潜袭者可以选择这个已破解子程序作为{card:爪钩}的目标，因为{card:爪钩}不会尝试破解被选中的那个子程序。当该能力结算时，{card:爪钩}会破解“[sub]造成1点核心伤害。”子程序，但不会对另一个“[sub]终止本次潜袭。”子程序做任何事，因为它已经被破解了。

original: 9.8.7. At {ref:step_resolve_subroutine} of an encounter, the Corp resolves subroutines that are unbroken with respect to that encounter.
translation: 在一次遭遇的{ref:step_resolve_subroutine}，公司结算就该次遭遇而言未破解的子程序。

original: 9.8.7.a. Resolving subroutines is mandatory and does not open a priority window.
translation: 结算子程序是强制的，且不会开启优先权窗口。

original: 9.8.7.b. The Corp resolves the unbroken subroutines 1 at a time in order. The order of subroutines is discussed in {ref:rule_subroutines_ordered}.
translation: 公司按顺序逐个结算未破解的子程序。关于子程序顺序，见{ref:rule_subroutines_ordered}。

original: 9.8.7.c. If the encounter ends during this process, no more subroutines are resolved.
translation: 如果在此过程中遭遇结束，则不再结算更多子程序。

original: The Runner encounters {card:Little Engine} and does not break any subroutines. {card:Little Engine}'s first subroutine resolves and ends the run. Since the run and therefore the encounter have ended, no more subroutines resolve. The Runner will not gain 5[c].
translation: 潜袭者遭遇{card:小火车}，且没有破解任何子程序。{card:小火车}的第一个子程序结算并终止本次潜袭。由于潜袭和遭遇都已结束，因此不会再有更多子程序结算。潜袭者不会获得5[c]。

original: 9.8.7.d. One card, {card:Street Magic}, allows the Runner to set the order in which subroutines are resolved. If this ability is active when {ref:step_resolve_subroutine} is reached for the first time in an encounter, the Runner declares an order for the unbroken subroutines, and the Corp must resolve them in this order instead of their normal order. The new order is determined before any subroutines are resolved.
translation: 有一张卡牌{card:街头魔术}允许潜袭者设定子程序的结算顺序。如果在一次遭遇中第一次到达{ref:step_resolve_subroutine}时，该能力处于现行状态，则潜袭者须为未破解子程序声明一个顺序，而公司必须按该顺序而非其通常顺序来结算它们。新的顺序会在任何子程序开始结算前确定。

original: 9.8.8. Once a subroutine's first instruction becomes imminent, the subroutine becomes independent of its source and {ref:rule_abilities_resolution_independent} applies to it.
translation: 一旦某个子程序的第一条指示变为即将发生，该子程序就脱离其来源而独立，并适用{ref:rule_abilities_resolution_independent}。

original: 9.8.9. One card, {card:Tsakhia "Bankhar" Gantulga}, can apply a replacement effect while a subroutine is imminent in order to resolve a different subroutine instead. The replaced subroutine is treated as having the same source as the original imminent subroutine.
translation: 有一张卡牌{card:查希亚·“蒙獒”·钢图拉嘎}可以在某个子程序即将发生时适用一个替代效果，以改为结算另一个子程序。被替代的子程序会被视为与原本即将发生的子程序具有相同的来源。

original: The Runner encounters {card:Bloop} while {card:Tsakhia "Bankhar" Gantulga}'s replacement effect applies. All 3 of {card:Bloop}'s subroutines would resolve, but are replaced by "[sub] Do 1 net damage." by the replacement effect. These subroutines count as resolving from {card:Bloop}, so when the Runner passes {card:Bloop} after the encounter, the Runner can use {card:Persephone} to trash the top card of their stack and the top 3 cards of R&D.
translation: 潜袭者在{card:查希亚·“蒙獒”·钢图拉嘎}的替代效果适用期间遭遇{card:海洋怪声}。{card:海洋怪声}的3个子程序本都会结算，但都被该替代效果改为“[sub]造成1点网络伤害。”。这些子程序仍被视为来自{card:海洋怪声}进行结算，因此当潜袭者在遭遇后通过{card:海洋怪声}时，其可以使用{card:珀耳塞福涅}来销毁其牌库顶端的1张牌以及研发中心顶端的3张牌。

original: 9.8.10. Steps of Resolving a Subroutine
translation: 结算子程序的步骤

original: 9.8.10.a. The subroutine itself becomes imminent.
translation: 该子程序本身变为即将发生。

original: 9.8.10.b. An interrupt window occurs, during which abilities can prevent the subroutine from resolving. If this happens, the remaining steps are not carried out.
translation: 开启一个打断窗口，此时能力可以防止该子程序结算。如果发生此情况，则不执行剩余步骤。

original: 9.8.10.c. Announce any targets for the subroutine's first instruction. That instruction then becomes imminent.
translation: 为该子程序的第一条指示宣告所有目标。然后该指示变为即将发生。

original: 9.8.10.d. An interrupt window occurs, during which abilities can modify, prevent, or avoid the imminent effects.
translation: 开启一个打断窗口，此时能力可以修改、防止或避免该即将发生的效果。

original: 9.8.10.e. Resolve the instruction, applying any changes to its effects from interrupts that were resolved.
translation: 结算该指示，并应用已结算之打断对其效果作出的任何改变。

original: 9.8.10.f. A checkpoint occurs.
translation: 进行一次检查点。

original: 9.8.10.g. If there are more instructions to resolve, announce any targets for the next instruction. That instruction then becomes imminent. Return to (d).
translation: 如果还有更多指示需要结算，则为下一条指示宣告所有目标。然后该指示变为即将发生。返回(d)。

original: 9.8.10.h. Resolution of the subroutine is complete.
translation: 该子程序结算完毕。

original: 9.9. Interrupts and Replacement Effects
translation: 打断与替代效果

original: 9.9.1. An {term:interrupt} is an ability that modifies either the effects of another instruction or the context in which that instruction will be resolved. Interrupts can be written in the form of a paid ability or a conditional ability.
translation: 一项{term:打断}是一种能力，它会修改另一条指示的效果，或修改该指示将要结算时所处的上下文。打断能力可以写成付费能力或条件能力的形式。

original: 9.9.1.a. Interrupt abilities are denoted by the [interrupt] symbol appearing at the beginning of the ability, or by certain keywords in the ability's text.
translation: 打断能力通过能力开头出现的[interrupt]符号，或通过能力文字中的某些关键词来表示。

original: 9.9.1.b. Any paid or conditional ability that uses the word "prevent", "avoid", or "would" is an interrupt ability.
translation: 任何使用“prevent”、“avoid”或“would”一词的付费能力或条件能力，都是打断能力。

original: 9.9.2. The {term:expected effects} of an imminent instruction are the effects described by the instruction's text, modified by any static abilities that affect it and any replacement effects or interrupt effects that have been applied. The expected effects of an instruction are continually updated throughout the interrupt window.
translation: 一条即将发生之指示的{term:预期效果}，是指该指示文字所描述的效果，并结合会影响它的任何持续能力，以及任何已经适用的替代效果或打断效果所作出的修改。指示的预期效果会在整个打断窗口期间持续更新。

original: The Runner plays {card:Process Automation} and the instruction "Gain 2[c] and draw 1 card." becomes imminent. The expected effects of this instruction are that the Runner will gain 2[c] and draw 1 card.
translation: 潜袭者打出{card:流程自动化}，而其指示“获得2[c]并抽1张牌。”变为即将发生。该指示的预期效果是潜袭者将获得2[c]并抽1张牌。

original: The Runner plays {card:Process Automation} after {card:Lockdown}'s subroutine resolves. The instruction "Gain 2[c] and draw 1 card." becomes imminent, but the Runner cannot draw cards. The expected effect of this instruction is that the Runner will gain 2[c].
translation: 在{card:禁闭}的子程序结算后，潜袭者打出{card:流程自动化}。其指示“获得2[c]并抽1张牌。”变为即将发生，但潜袭者不能抽牌。该指示的预期效果是潜袭者将获得2[c]。

original: 9.9.2.a. When an instruction resolves, its expected effects correspond to the effects that occur, except for situations where {ref:rule_negative_values_resolution} applies.
translation: 当一条指示结算时，其预期效果对应于实际发生的效果，但适用{ref:rule_negative_values_resolution}的情形除外。

original: 9.9.3. In order to trigger an interrupt, it must be {term:relevant} to an imminent instruction. An interrupt is relevant to an instruction if at least one of the following is true:
translation: 为了触发一项打断，它必须与某条即将发生的指示{term:相关}。如果满足以下任一条件，则该打断与该指示相关：

original: 9.9.3.a. Its effects could prevent or avoid part or all of the imminent instruction's expected effects. See {ref:sec_prevent_avoid}.
translation: 其效果可以防止或避免该即将发生之指示的全部或部分预期效果。见{ref:sec_prevent_avoid}。

original: 9.9.3.b. Its effects could modify a value associated with the imminent instruction's expected effects. See {ref:sec_modifiable_values} and {ref:sec_calculating_expected_effect_values}.
translation: 其效果可以修改与该即将发生之指示预期效果相关的某个数值。见{ref:sec_modifiable_values}和{ref:sec_calculating_expected_effect_values}。

original: 9.9.3.c. Its effects could create a replacement effect that applies to the imminent instruction's expected effects. See {ref:rule_replace_imminent_effects}.
translation: 其效果可以创造一个适用于该即将发生之指示预期效果的替代效果。见{ref:rule_replace_imminent_effects}。

original: 9.9.3.d. It has a trigger condition using the word "would" that is met by the imminent instruction's expected effects.
translation: 它具有一个使用“would”一词的触发条件，而该触发条件会被该即将发生之指示的预期效果所满足。

original: The trigger condition on {card:The Class Act}'s second ability is "The first time each turn you would draw any number of cards". Even though this ability's effects do not directly modify the imminent instruction's effects, the ability is relevant to an instruction that is expected to draw cards.
translation: {card:一流选手}第二个能力的触发条件是“每回合第一次你将要抽任意数量的牌时”。即使该能力的效果不会直接修改即将发生之指示的效果，只要某条指示的预期效果是抽牌，该能力就与之相关。

original: 9.9.4. Whenever an instruction becomes imminent, an interrupt window opens to allow players to modify the effects of that instruction. {ref:Rule_interrupt_window} contains the rules for handling priority during interrupt windows.
translation: 每当一条指示变为即将发生时，都会开启一个打断窗口，以允许玩家修改该指示的效果。{ref:Rule_interrupt_window}包含关于在打断窗口期间如何处理优先权的规则。

original: 9.9.4.a. As the window opens, the initial expected effects of the instruction are determined, then any active replacement effects that replace all or part of the expected effects are applied. If multiple replacement effects could apply, the order in which they are applied follows the rules in {ref:rule_order_of_replacement_effects}.
translation: 当该窗口开启时，先确定该指示最初的预期效果，然后适用任何会替代这些预期效果全部或部分的现行替代效果。如果有多个替代效果都可以适用，则其适用顺序遵循{ref:rule_order_of_replacement_effects}。

original: 9.9.4.b. After replacement effects have been applied, but before players receive priority, active conditional ability interrupts that are relevant to the imminent instruction are marked pending and are associated with the window. If a conditional ability interrupt becomes active after the interrupt window opens, it does not become pending.
translation: 在替代效果适用之后、玩家获得优先权之前，与该即将发生之指示相关的现行条件能力打断会被标记为待结算，并与该窗口关联。如果一项条件能力打断是在打断窗口开启后才变为现行，则它不会变为待结算。

original: 9.9.4.c. While a player has priority in an interrupt window, they can trigger a conditional ability interrupt they control only if it is pending in that window and still relevant to the imminent instruction.
translation: 当玩家在某个打断窗口中拥有优先权时，只有当其操控的一项条件能力打断在该窗口中处于待结算状态，且仍与该即将发生之指示相关时，该玩家才能触发它。

original: An instruction is imminent that would trash an installed copy of {card:Harbinger}. The Runner uses {card:Sacrificial Construct} to prevent {card:Harbinger} from being trashed. The Runner can no longer trigger {card:Harbinger}'s interrupt ability, even though it is still pending, because the expected effects of the instruction no longer include {card:Harbinger} being trashed and therefore the ability is no longer relevant.
translation: 有一条指示即将发生，其将销毁一个已安装的{card:先驱}。潜袭者使用{card:自毁结构体}来防止{card:先驱}被销毁。即使{card:先驱}的打断能力仍处于待结算状态，潜袭者也不能再触发它，因为该指示的预期效果已不再包括销毁{card:先驱}，因此该能力不再相关。

original: An instruction is imminent that would give the Runner 2 tags. The Runner trashes {card:Decoy} to use its ability to avoid 1 of the tags, which meets the trigger condition for {card:Thunder Art Gallery}'s ability. The latter resolves as a chain reaction (see {ref:rule_chain_reaction}) while the interrupt window is still open, allowing the Runner to install {card:No One Home}, which has a conditional ability interrupt that is relevant since the instruction is still expected to give the Runner 1 tag. However, {card:No One Home} was not active when the interrupt window opened, so its ability is not pending and cannot be triggered.
translation: 有一条指示即将发生，其将给予潜袭者2个锁定。潜袭者销毁{card:虚假目标}以使用其能力，避免其中1个锁定，这满足了{card:雷鸣画廊}能力的触发条件。后者在打断窗口仍然开启时以连锁反应的方式结算（见{ref:rule_chain_reaction}），让潜袭者得以安装{card:家中无人}。{card:家中无人}具有一项条件能力打断，由于该指示仍预期会给予潜袭者1个锁定，所以这项打断是相关的。然而，{card:家中无人}在打断窗口开启时并未处于现行状态，因此其能力不是待结算，不能被触发。

original: 9.9.4.d. While a player has priority in an interrupt window, they can use a paid ability interrupt that is relevant to the imminent instruction. The ability does not have to have been active when the interrupt window opened, nor does a paid ability window need to be open at this time.
translation: 当玩家在某个打断窗口中拥有优先权时，其可以使用一项与该即将发生之指示相关的付费能力打断。该能力不需要在打断窗口开启时就已处于现行状态，此时也不需要有一个付费能力窗口处于开启状态。

original: An instruction is imminent that would give the Runner 2 tags. The Runner trashes {card:Decoy} to use its ability to avoid 1 of the tags, which meets the trigger condition for {card:Thunder Art Gallery}'s ability. The latter resolves as a chain reaction (see {ref:rule_chain_reaction}) while the interrupt window is still open, allowing the Runner to install another copy of {card:Decoy}. The Runner receives priority again in the original interrupt window and uses the second {card:Decoy}'s ability to avoid the other imminent tag.
translation: 有一条指示即将发生，其将给予潜袭者2个锁定。潜袭者销毁{card:虚假目标}以使用其能力，避免其中1个锁定，这满足了{card:雷鸣画廊}能力的触发条件。后者在打断窗口仍然开启时以连锁反应的方式结算（见{ref:rule_chain_reaction}），让潜袭者得以安装另一张{card:虚假目标}。潜袭者随后在原本的打断窗口中再次获得优先权，并使用第二张{card:虚假目标}的能力来避免另一个即将发生的锁定。

original: 9.9.5. To {term:prevent} or {term:avoid} an effect is to stop that effect from happening. The terms "prevent" and "avoid" are synonymous.
translation: 要{term:防止}或{term:避免}一个效果，就是阻止该效果发生。“prevent”和“avoid”这两个词是同义的。

original: 9.9.5.a. Some abilities look for an ordinal instance of an effect that "would" take place within a specified time period. These abilities look for the appropriate number of times that effect becomes imminent, not whether the effect actually resolves. Preventing or replacing an effect does not allow these abilities to meet their trigger conditions again in the same time period.
translation: 某些能力会寻找在指定时间段内“would”发生的某个效果的第几个实例。这些能力关注的是该效果第几次变为即将发生，而不是该效果实际上是否结算。防止或替代一个效果，不会让这些能力在同一时间段内再次满足其触发条件。

original: {card:Tori Hanzō}'s interrupt can only be used "the first time you would do net damage" during a run. If the first net damage that becomes imminent is prevented by the Runner using {card:Feedback Filter}, {card:Tori Hanzō} cannot be used on any other instances of net damage for the remainder of the run, as the next imminent net damage is the second time the Corp "would" deal net damage, not the first time.
translation: 在一次潜袭中，{card:半藏冬莉}的打断只能用于“the first time you would do net damage”。如果第一次变为即将发生的网络伤害被潜袭者使用{card:反馈式过滤器}防止了，那么在该次潜袭的剩余时间里，{card:半藏冬莉}便不能再用于任何其他网络伤害实例，因为下一次即将发生的网络伤害是公司“would”造成网络伤害的第二次，而不是第一次。

original: 9.9.5.b. Abilities that do not use "would" do not see effects that are prevented, as those effects did not occur.
translation: 不使用“would”的能力看不到被防止的效果，因为这些效果并未发生。

original: 9.9.6. Some instructions make use of an associated value. These values can be changed by interrupts and replacement effects.
translation: 可修改的数值

original: 9.9.6.a. A number of tags the Runner would take from an effect is a value. Avoiding a number of those tags decreases that value. The value for a number of tags the Runner takes must be greater than 0 for the effect giving tags to occur.
translation: 潜袭者将因某个效果获得的锁定数量是一个数值。避免其中若干个锁定，会减少该数值。只有当潜袭者获得锁定的数值大于0时，给予锁定的效果才会发生。

original: 9.9.6.b. An amount of damage the Runner would take from an effect is a value. Preventing an amount of that damage decreases that value. The value for an amount of damage the Runner takes must be greater than 0 for the damage effect to occur.
translation: 潜袭者将因某个效果受到的伤害数量是一个数值。防止其中若干点伤害，会减少该数值。只有当潜袭者受到伤害的数值大于0时，伤害效果才会发生。

original: 9.9.6.c. A cost that would be paid while resolving an effect is a value. {ref:Rule_cost_calculation} applies to the final value at the time the cost is paid. See also {ref:rule_cost_zero}.
translation: 在结算一个效果时将支付的费用是一个数值。支付该费用时的最终数值适用{ref:Rule_cost_calculation}。另见{ref:rule_cost_zero}。

original: {card:Patchwork}'s interrupt modifies a play cost or install cost, so it is relevant to any instruction where a card will be played or installed and the corresponding cost paid.
translation: {card:补丁}的打断会修改打出费用或安装费用，因此它与任何将要打出或安装一张卡牌并支付相应费用的指示都相关。

original: 9.9.6.d. The base trace strength of a trace attempt is a value. See {ref:sec_traces} for rules about trace attempts. A base trace strength value does not need to be greater than 0 for the trace attempt to occur.
translation: 追踪尝试的基础追踪强度是一个数值。关于追踪尝试的规则见{ref:sec_traces}。基础追踪强度的数值不需要大于0，追踪尝试仍然可以发生。

original: 9.9.7. Values associated with an imminent instruction are calculated continuously as part of the instruction's expected effects.
translation: 即将发生之指示相关的数值，会作为该指示预期效果的一部分被持续计算。

original: 9.9.7.a. While an instruction is imminent, values associated with that instruction can be reduced below 0. Values 0 or lower can still be modified by other interrupt abilities while the instruction remains imminent.
translation: 当一条指示即将发生时，与该指示相关的数值可以被减少到0以下。只要该指示仍处于即将发生状态，数值为0或更低时，其他打断能力仍然可以修改这些数值。

original: The Runner takes a tag on their turn, allowing the Corp to trigger {card:Mr. Stone}. While the 1 meat damage from {card:Mr. Stone}'s ability is imminent, both players can trigger interrupts to modify the damage effect. Since it is the Runner's turn, they receive priority first and use {card:Biometric Spoofing} to prevent 2 damage. The imminent effect is now expected to do -1 damage. When the Corp receives priority, they trigger two copies of {card:The Cleaners} that each add 1 to the expected damage, increasing the total to 0 and then to 1. The ability will resolve with 1 damage even though the amount of damage was temporarily 0 or less while the effect was imminent.
translation: 潜袭者在其回合中获得1个锁定，使公司能够触发{card:斯通先生}。当{card:斯通先生}能力造成的1点肉体伤害即将发生时，双方玩家都可以触发打断来修改该伤害效果。由于当前是潜袭者的回合，潜袭者先获得优先权，并使用{card:冒用生物特征}防止2点伤害。该即将发生的效果现在预期会造成-1点伤害。当公司获得优先权时，其触发两张{card:清除者}，每张都将预期伤害增加1，使总数先变为0再变为1。即使该效果在即将发生期间伤害量曾暂时为0或更低，该能力结算时仍将造成1点伤害。

original: 9.9.7.b. If an effect prevents "all damage" or "any amount of damage" while an instruction is imminent, the damage is removed from the expected effects entirely, and there is no longer a value to be modified. If an effect avoids "all tags" or "any number of tags" while an instruction is imminent, taking tags is removed from the expected effects entirely, and there is no longer a value to be modified.
translation: 如果在某条指示即将发生时，一个效果防止“所有伤害”或“任意数量的伤害”，则伤害会从预期效果中被完全移除，因而不再有可被修改的数值。如果在某条指示即将发生时，一个效果避免“所有锁定”或“任意数量的锁定”，则获得锁定会从预期效果中被完全移除，因而不再有可被修改的数值。

original: The Runner installs {card:Net-Ready Eyes} and uses {card:Chrome Parlor} to prevent all of the damage from its first ability. There is no longer an imminent damage effect, so the Corp cannot use {card:The Cleaners}.
translation: 潜袭者安装{card:网备视眼}，并使用{card:铬金改造院}来防止其第一个能力造成的所有伤害。此时不再存在即将发生的伤害效果，因此公司不能使用{card:清除者}。

original: 9.9.7.c. One card, {card:Bio-Modeled Network}, has an instruction that prevents "all but 1 net damage." This ability is relevant when the imminent instruction's expected effects include doing net damage and the amount of the damage is 2 or more. The effect of this ability is to set the value for the amount of damage to 1. Previously-applied modifiers to the value are ignored. The value can still be modified by other interrupts after being set to 1 this way.
translation: 有一张卡牌{card:生物建模网络}具有一条指示，可防止“除1点以外的所有网络伤害”。当即将发生之指示的预期效果包含造成网络伤害，且伤害量为2或更多时，该能力便是相关的。该能力的效果是将伤害数量这一数值设为1。此前已适用于该数值的修正会被忽略。在如此被设为1之后，该数值仍可以被其他打断继续修改。

original: 9.9.7.d. Some types of values must be greater than 0 for the associated effect to occur. See {ref:sec_modifiable_values}. At the time an instruction resolves, if any value of one of those types is 0 or less, as much of that ability resolves as possible without applying the part of the effect making use of that value, following {ref:rule_if_able,rule_do_as_much_as_you_can} of the Golden Rules.
translation: 某些类型的数值必须大于0，其相关效果才会发生。见{ref:sec_modifiable_values}。在一条指示结算时，如果任何此类数值为0或更低，则依照黄金规则中的{ref:rule_if_able,rule_do_as_much_as_you_can}，在不适用该数值所对应效果部分的前提下，尽可能结算该能力的其他部分。

original: The Runner accesses {card:Breached Dome}. While the instruction from its "when accessed" ability is imminent, the Runner uses {card:Biometric Spoofing} to prevent 2 damage. When the ability resolves, the value for the amount of damage is -1, which is less than or equal to 0, so the damage effect cannot occur and the Corp only trashes the top card of the stack.
translation: 潜袭者读取{card:破裂穹顶}。当其“when accessed”能力所产生的指示即将发生时，潜袭者使用{card:冒用生物特征}防止2点伤害。当该能力结算时，伤害数量的数值为-1，小于或等于0，因此伤害效果不能发生，公司只会销毁潜袭者牌库顶端的那张牌。

original: 9.9.7.e. Any effects making use of modified values maintain their restrictions and specifications with the new values.
translation: 任何使用了被修改数值的效果，都会在新数值下保留其原有的限制与规定。

original: While the result of a successful trace from {card:Flare} is imminent, the Corp triggers {card:The Cleaners} to increase the imminent meat damage by 1. Even though the damage from {card:Flare} has been increased from 2 to 3, none of that meat damage can be prevented.
translation: 当{card:耀斑}成功追踪的结果即将发生时，公司触发{card:清除者}将该即将发生的肉体伤害增加1。虽然{card:耀斑}造成的肉体伤害已从2增加到3，但这些肉体伤害中的任何一点仍然都不能被防止。

original: 9.9.7.f. One card, {card:Guru Davinder}, has a non-interrupt conditional ability with the trigger condition "Whenever this resource prevents 1 or more damage". The trigger condition is met when the following occurs: the expected effects of an imminent instruction include a damage effect with a value greater than 0 for the amount of the damage; an interrupt ability resolves from the same source object as the conditional ability; and the interrupt decreases the value for the damage amount or removes the damage effect entirely.
translation: 有一张卡牌{card:古鲁达温德}具有一项非打断的条件能力，其触发条件是“Whenever this resource prevents 1 or more damage”。当发生以下情况时，该触发条件会被满足：某条即将发生之指示的预期效果包含一个伤害效果，且该伤害数量大于0；一项来自与该条件能力相同来源对象的打断能力完成结算；并且该打断使伤害数量的数值减少，或将该伤害效果完全移除。

original: The Runner accesses {card:Angelique Garza Correa} and the Corp pays 2[c], making the "Do 2 meat damage" instruction imminent. The Runner uses {card:Plascrete Carapace} to prevent 2 meat damage, leaving the imminent instruction with the expected effect "Do 0 meat damage.". At this point, the 0 value for the damage can still be modified by abilities like {card:The Cleaners}. But then the Runner resolves the interrupt ability on {card:Guru Davinder}, which removes the damage effect altogether. Since the value for the damage was 0, {card:Guru Davinder}'s second ability does not meet its trigger condition and the Runner does not have to trash {card:Guru Davinder} or pay 4[c]. There is no longer an imminent damage effect, so the Corp cannot use {card:The Cleaners}.
translation: 潜袭者读取{card:安吉丽克·加尔萨·科雷亚}，而公司支付2[c]，使“造成2点肉体伤害。”这条指示变为即将发生。潜袭者使用{card:凝塑铠甲}防止2点肉体伤害，使该即将发生之指示的预期效果变为“造成0点肉体伤害。”。此时，伤害的0值仍然可以被{card:清除者}之类的能力修改。但随后潜袭者结算{card:古鲁达温德}上的打断能力，将该伤害效果彻底移除。由于伤害数值已经是0，{card:古鲁达温德}的第二个能力并不会满足其触发条件，因此潜袭者不必销毁{card:古鲁达温德}，也不必支付4[c]。此时已经不再存在即将发生的伤害效果，因此公司不能使用{card:清除者}。

original: 9.9.8. A {term:replacement effect} modifies another effect by replacing some or all of the original effect's behavior with different behavior. Replacement effects are indicated by the word "instead" in their text. Once created, replacement effects apply automatically and do not require players to explicitly trigger them.
translation: 替代效果

original: 9.9.8.a. Interrupts can introduce replacement effects that apply to the currently imminent instruction. See {ref:rule_replace_imminent_effects}.
translation: 打断可以引入适用于当前即将发生之指示的替代效果。见{ref:rule_replace_imminent_effects}。

original: 9.9.8.b. Static abilities can stipulate replacement effects that apply whenever appropriate while the static ability is active.
translation: 持续能力可以规定替代效果，只要该持续能力处于现行状态，它们就在适当时机适用。

original: 9.9.8.c. Other abilities can create replacement effects ahead of time, which apply to effects that could happen later. This is a type of lingering effect (see {ref:sec_lingering_effects}).
translation: 其他能力也可以预先创造替代效果，以适用于之后可能发生的效果。这是一种残留效果（见{ref:sec_lingering_effects}）。

original: 9.9.9. Replacement effects most commonly apply to the effects of an instruction, but some apply to static abilities or alter the durations of lingering effects.
translation: 替代效果最常见的是适用于某条指示的效果，但也有些会适用于持续能力，或改变残留效果的持续时间。

original: 9.9.9.a. If a replacement effect modifies the effects of a static ability or the duration of a lingering effect, this modification applies continuously for as long as the replacement effect itself is active, and no longer applies once the replacement effect or the original effect being modified becomes inactive.
translation: 如果某个替代效果修改的是持续能力的效果，或修改的是残留效果的持续时间，那么只要该替代效果本身仍处于现行状态，这种修改就会持续适用；一旦该替代效果或被修改的原效果变为非现行状态，这种修改便不再适用。

original: {card:Gebrselassie}'s static ability replaces the durations of certain lingering effects affecting its host with a duration of "for the remainder of the turn." If {card:Gebrselassie} is uninstalled or moved to a different host, its replacement effect no longer applies to those lingering effects, so they revert to their normal durations. If any of those durations have already expired, the corresponding effects will end at the next checkpoint.
translation: {card:格布雷西拉西耶}的持续能力会将某些影响其宿主的残留效果之持续时间替代为“本回合的剩余时间内”。如果{card:格布雷西拉西耶}被卸载，或被转移到不同的宿主上，则其替代效果不再适用于那些残留效果，它们会恢复为正常持续时间。如果其中任何持续时间此时已经届满，则相应效果会在下一次检查点结束。

original: 9.9.9.b. If an active replacement effect can apply to the expected effects of an imminent instruction, it is applied as the interrupt window opens, and the expected effects of the instruction are updated accordingly. This happens before the expected effects are checked for relevant active abilities that could become pending. Replacement effects created by interrupts will not yet be active at this time and are applied according to {ref:rule_replace_imminent_effects} instead.
translation: 如果某个现行的替代效果可以适用于一条即将发生之指示的预期效果，则它会在打断窗口开启时被适用，并据此更新该指示的预期效果。这发生在检查哪些相关的现行能力会变为待结算之前。由打断所创造的替代效果此时尚未处于现行状态，它们会改为依照{ref:rule_replace_imminent_effects}来适用。

original: 9.9.9.c. Each replacement effect can only apply once to any single effect. Once a replacement effect has been applied, even if the new effect it creates (or a new effect created by a later replacement effect) still includes an occurrence of the effect that gets replaced, the same replacement effect cannot be applied to that effect again.
translation: 每个替代效果对于任何单个效果都只能适用1次。一旦某个替代效果已经适用，即使它所创造的新效果（或较后适用的另一个替代效果所创造的新效果）仍然包含被替代之效果的一次发生，该同一个替代效果也不能再次适用于该效果。

original: The Runner accesses {card:Project Vacheron} and its interrupt ability resolves. The interrupt creates a replacement effect that will override adding the agenda to the Runner's score area. The Runner will still steal {card:Project Vacheron}, but they will do so by adding it to their score area with hosted agenda counters. Even though the modified effect still includes adding {card:Project Vacheron} to the Runner's score area, there is no way for the replacement effect to apply again to its own results.
translation: 潜袭者读取{card:瓦什隆计划}，其打断能力完成结算。该打断创造了一个替代效果，会改写将该议案加入潜袭者计分区的过程。潜袭者仍会窃取{card:瓦什隆计划}，但其方式会变为：将其带有议案指示物地加入潜袭者的计分区。即使该修改后的效果仍然包含将{card:瓦什隆计划}加入潜袭者计分区，也没有办法让这个替代效果再次适用于它自己的结果。

original: 9.9.10. Some interrupts create replacement effects to modify an instruction that is already imminent. When the interrupt resolves, if the replacement effect can apply to the expected effects of the imminent instruction, it is applied immediately.
translation: 某些打断会创造替代效果，以修改已经即将发生的一条指示。当该打断结算时，如果该替代效果可以适用于该即将发生之指示的预期效果，则其会立即适用。

original: An instruction is imminent with an expected effect of the Corp doing net damage to the Runner. The Corp uses {card:Tori Hanzō}'s ability, creating a replacement effect replacing net damage with core damage. The replacement effect applies immediately, so after {card:Tori Hanzō}'s ability resolves, the expected effect is now to do 1 core damage. When players get priority again, their interrupts are relevant or not based on the new expected effects.
translation: 有一条指示即将发生，其预期效果是公司对潜袭者造成网络伤害。公司使用{card:半藏冬莉}的能力，创造一个以核心伤害替代网络伤害的替代效果。该替代效果会立即适用，因此在{card:半藏冬莉}的能力结算后，预期效果就变为造成1点核心伤害。当玩家再次获得优先权时，他们的打断是否相关，便要根据新的预期效果来判断。

original: 9.9.11. If multiple replacement effects would apply to an effect acting on a targeted card, that card's controller chooses the order in which the replacement effects apply. If multiple replacement effects would apply to any other effect, the controller of the base effect chooses the order in which the replacement effects apply.
translation: 如果有多个替代效果将适用于一个作用于已选定目标卡牌的效果，则由该卡牌的操控者选择这些替代效果的适用顺序。如果有多个替代效果将适用于任何其他效果，则由基础效果的操控者选择这些替代效果的适用顺序。

original: 9.9.11.a. After applying one replacement effect, a subsequent replacement effect can only be applied if the effect it was to replace is still expected. A replacement effect cannot apply without something to replace.
translation: 在适用一个替代效果之后，只有当它原本要替代的那个效果仍然被预期发生时，后续的替代效果才能适用。没有可替代之内容，替代效果就不能适用。

original: The Runner chooses HQ with {card:Security Testing} when their turn begins, then plays {card:Account Siphon}. When the run becomes successful, both {card:Security Testing} and {card:Account Siphon} create replacement effects. When {ref:step_breach} of the run becomes imminent, the Runner must choose to apply either the replacement effect from {card:Security Testing} or the one from {card:Account Siphon}. Since neither effect creates a new instance of breaching the server, the effect not chosen to apply first has nothing to replace and does not apply.
translation: 潜袭者在其回合开始时为{card:安全测试}选择总部，然后打出{card:账户虹吸}。当该次潜袭变为成功时，{card:安全测试}与{card:账户虹吸}都会创造替代效果。当该次潜袭的{ref:step_breach}变为即将发生时，潜袭者必须选择先适用{card:安全测试}的替代效果或{card:账户虹吸}的替代效果之一。由于这两个效果都不会创造一个新的侵入服务器实例，未先被选中的那个效果将无内容可替代，因此不会适用。

original: The Runner chooses R&D with {card:Security Testing} when their turn begins, then plays {card:Showing Off}. When a run on R&D becomes successful, both {card:Security Testing} and {card:Showing Off} create replacement effects. When {ref:step_breach} of the run becomes imminent, the Runner must choose to apply either the replacement effect from {card:Security Testing} or the one from {card:Showing Off}. If they choose to apply {card:Security Testing} first, {card:Showing Off}'s effect has nothing to replace and does not apply. If they choose to apply {card:Showing Off} first, the expected effects still include breaching R&D, albeit not in the usual way. {card:Security Testing} can still replace this breach, so it applies next. Either way, the Runner will gain 2[c] and will not breach the server.
translation: 潜袭者在其回合开始时为{card:安全测试}选择研发中心，然后打出{card:卖弄}。当对研发中心的潜袭变为成功时，{card:安全测试}与{card:卖弄}都会创造替代效果。当该次潜袭的{ref:step_breach}变为即将发生时，潜袭者必须选择先适用{card:安全测试}的替代效果或{card:卖弄}的替代效果之一。如果其先适用{card:安全测试}，则{card:卖弄}的效果将无内容可替代，因此不会适用。如果其先适用{card:卖弄}，则预期效果仍然包含对研发中心的侵入，只是方式不同于通常情况。{card:安全测试}仍然可以替代这次侵入，因此会接着适用。无论哪种情况，潜袭者都会获得2[c]，且不会侵入该服务器。

original: 9.10. Lingering Effects
translation: 残留效果

original: 9.10.1. Instructions can create {term:lingering effects} that exist beyond their resolution. Once a lingering effect is created, it exists independently of its source even if the source becomes inactive. Lingering effects remain active only for the duration specified in the instruction that created them. Lingering effects with durations that have expired are removed from the game state at {ref:step_checkpoint_duration_abilities} of each checkpoint.
translation: 指示可以创造在其结算之后仍继续存在的{term:残留效果}。残留效果一经创建，便独立于其来源而存在，即使来源变为非现行状态也是如此。残留效果只会在创建它的指示所指定的持续时间内保持现行。持续时间已经届满的残留效果，会在每次检查点的{ref:step_checkpoint_duration_abilities}从游戏状态中移除。

original: 9.10.2. Some lingering effects exist only to maintain the existence of another ability. Delayed conditional abilities are maintained this way and may have an implicit duration. See {ref:rule_delayed_conditional_ability}.
translation: 某些残留效果的存在，仅仅是为了维持另一项能力的存在。延时条件能力就是以这种方式被维持的，并且可能具有隐含的持续时间。见{ref:rule_delayed_conditional_ability}。

original: 9.10.3. Some lingering effects maintain a choice that a player made while resolving an ability in order for another ability or effect with the same source object to make use of that choice.
translation: 某些残留效果会维持玩家在结算一项能力时所作出的选择，以供具有相同来源对象的另一项能力或效果使用该选择。

original: 9.10.3.a. If the choice is only referred to by another lingering effect, the lingering effect maintaining the choice has the same duration as the other lingering effect.
translation: 如果该选择只被另一项残留效果所引用，则维持该选择的残留效果与另一项残留效果具有相同的持续时间。

original: The Runner resolves {card:Pelangi}'s paid ability and chooses an ice subtype. The ability then creates a lingering effect adding the chosen subtype to the encountered ice. Both the choice of subtype and the effect adding it to the ice expire at the end of the encounter.
translation: 潜袭者结算{card:虹彩}的付费能力，并选择一个防火墙子类别。该能力随后创造一个残留效果，为所遭遇的防火墙添加所选子类别。对子类别的选择，以及将其添加给该防火墙的效果，都会在遭遇结束时失效。

original: 9.10.3.b. If a conditional ability has a "when your turn begins" trigger condition and no effects other than making a choice, the duration of the lingering effect maintaining the choice expires when that turn ends or the source object becomes inactive.
translation: 如果一项条件能力的触发条件是“when your turn begins”，且其效果除作出一个选择之外别无其他，那么维持该选择的残留效果之持续时间会在该回合结束或来源对象变为非现行状态时失效。

original: {card:Security Testing}'s first ability reads, "When your turn begins, you may choose a server." The choice made when resolving this ability on a particular turn should be maintained only until that turn ends. The trigger condition of {card:Security Testing}'s second ability refers to the chosen server, and it will always look for the server chosen this turn. A successful run on a server that was not chosen this turn will never meet that trigger condition, even if no server was chosen this turn.
translation: {card:安全测试}的第一个能力写着：“When your turn begins, you may choose a server.”在某个回合中结算该能力时所作出的选择，只应维持到该回合结束。{card:安全测试}第二个能力的触发条件会引用被选择的服务器，而它总是寻找本回合所选择的服务器。对一个本回合未被选中的服务器进行成功潜袭，绝不会满足该触发条件，即使本回合根本没有选任何服务器也是如此。

original: 9.10.3.c. If the previous cases do not apply, the duration of the lingering effect expires only when the source object becomes inactive.
translation: 如果前述情况都不适用，则该残留效果的持续时间只有在来源对象变为非现行状态时才会失效。

original: {card:Femme Fatale}'s first conditional ability directs the Runner to choose an installed piece of ice. Which ice was chosen is maintained as a lingering effect for as long as {card:Femme Fatale} remains active, and its last ability refers to the object that is being remembered by that lingering effect.
translation: {card:蛇蝎美人}的第一个条件能力指示潜袭者选择一张已安装的防火墙。被选择的是哪张防火墙，会以残留效果的形式被维持，只要{card:蛇蝎美人}保持现行状态即可；其最后一个能力所提及的，正是该残留效果所记住的对象。

original: 9.10.4. If a lingering effect is created with a duration based on a timing structure that is not in progress at the time the lingering effect is created, the duration expires immediately, and the lingering effect persists only until the next checkpoint after it is created.
translation: 如果某个残留效果在被创建时，其持续时间是基于一个当时并未进行中的时序结构，则其持续时间会立即失效，而该残留效果只会持续到其创建后的下一次检查点。

original: 9.10.4.a. Abilities on an {subtype:icebreaker} that modify their source's strength have an implicit duration of "for the remainder of the current encounter". See {ref:rule_icebreaker_strength_increase_implicit}.
translation: 破解器上会修改其来源强度的能力，具有一个隐含的持续时间：“在当前遭遇的剩余时间内”。见{ref:rule_icebreaker_strength_increase_implicit}。

original: 9.10.5. Only lingering effects have durations. An ability that modifies the durations of other abilities functions by keeping their corresponding lingering effects active until an additional duration expires. This type of ability does not interact with effects from static abilities.
translation: 只有残留效果具有持续时间。修改其他能力持续时间的能力，其运作方式是让那些能力所对应的残留效果保持现行，直到某个额外持续时间失效为止。这类能力不会与持续能力产生的效果互动。

original: The Runner controls {card:Gebrselassie} hosted on {card:Na'Not'K}. They run a server protected by 3 pieces of ice, and use {card:Na'Not'K}'s last ability to raise its strength to a total of 6. When the run ends, {card:Na'Not'K}'s static ability will no longer provide +3 strength, but the lingering effect of +2 strength from its paid ability will be maintained by {card:Gebrselassie} until the turn ends or {card:Gebrselassie} stops being hosted on {card:Na'Not'K}. If the Runner makes another run on a server protected by only 1 piece of ice, {card:Na'Not'K} will have 4 strength when that run begins.
translation: 潜袭者操控附载在{card:纳补科}上的{card:格布雷西拉西耶}。其对一个受3张防火墙保护的服务器进行潜袭，并使用{card:纳补科}的最后一个能力将其强度提升到总计6。当该次潜袭结束时，{card:纳补科}的持续能力将不再提供+3强度，但其付费能力所产生的+2强度残留效果，会被{card:格布雷西拉西耶}维持到回合结束，或直到{card:格布雷西拉西耶}不再附载于{card:纳补科}之上。如果潜袭者随后又对一个只受1张防火墙保护的服务器发起潜袭，则在那次潜袭开始时，{card:纳补科}将具有4点强度。

original: 9.11. Identifying Instructions
translation: 识别指示

original: To correctly resolve conditional abilities and interrupts that could meet their trigger conditions during the resolution of another ability (see {ref:rule_chain_reaction}), players need to determine where checkpoints occur during the resolution of each ability. This section aids players in making this determination. For clarifications on particular cards, refer to the Rulings section of that card's page on {link:netrunnerdb.com|https://www.netrunnerdb.com}.
translation: 为了正确结算那些在另一项能力结算期间可能满足其触发条件的条件能力与打断（见{ref:rule_chain_reaction}），玩家需要判断每项能力结算过程中何处会发生检查点。本节帮助玩家作出此判断。若需关于特定卡牌的澄清，请参阅{link:netrunnerdb.com|https://www.netrunnerdb.com}上该卡牌页面的“Rulings”部分。

original: 9.11.1. An instruction normally cannot be paused once it begins to resolve. An instruction can only be paused if a checkpoint opens in the middle of its resolution, which only occurs in the following cases:
translation: 一条指示通常在开始结算后不能暂停。只有当其结算过程中间开启检查点时，指示才能被暂停，而这只会在以下情形发生：

original: 9.11.1.a. Any time a cost is paid, a checkpoint must occur immediately afterward.
translation: 每当支付一个费用后，都必须立即进行一次检查点。

original: 9.11.1.b. When a timing structure is opened, the checkpoints in that timing structure are carried out. See {ref:rule_timing_structure} for a list of timing structures.
translation: 当一个时序结构被开启时，该时序结构中的各个检查点都会被执行。关于时序结构的列表，见{ref:rule_timing_structure}。

original: 9.11.1.c. When a player draws cards, a checkpoint occurs at {ref:step_draw_checkpoint} of that procedure.
translation: 当玩家抽牌时，该流程的{ref:step_draw_checkpoint}会进行一次检查点。

original: 9.11.1.d. When an event or operation is played, a checkpoint occurs at {ref:rule_steps_playing_played_checkpoint} of that procedure.
translation: 当打出事件牌或事务时，该流程的{ref:rule_steps_playing_played_checkpoint}会进行一次检查点。

original: 9.11.1.e. When a trace is initiated, a checkpoint occurs at {ref:step_trace_checkpoint} of that procedure.
translation: 当一次追踪被发起时，该流程的{ref:step_trace_checkpoint}会进行一次检查点。

original: 9.11.2. Each step in a timing structure forms a single instruction, and is accordingly preceded by an interrupt window and followed by a checkpoint.
translation: 时序结构中的每个步骤都构成单独的一条指示，因此其前面都有一个打断窗口，后面都有一个检查点。

original: 9.11.2.a. Some game procedures that are not timing structures are presented as a sequence of steps. These steps do not indicate instruction boundaries, and checkpoints only occur in these procedures when explicitly called for.
translation: 某些并非时序结构的游戏流程也会以步骤序列的形式呈现。这些步骤并不表示指示边界，在这些流程中只有明确要求时才会发生检查点。

original: The steps of installing a card are not separate instructions. Installing a card usually happens in its entirety as part of a single instruction. The only checkpoint that occurs during the procedure of installing a card is at {ref:rule_steps_installing_pay_install_cost}, immediately after the install cost is paid.
translation: 安装卡牌的各个步骤并不是彼此独立的指示。安装一张卡牌通常会整体作为单一指示的一部分发生。安装流程中唯一会发生的检查点，是在支付安装费用之后的{ref:rule_steps_installing_pay_install_cost}。

original: The steps of a checkpoint are not instructions. No checkpoints take place in the middle of another checkpoint.
translation: 检查点的各个步骤并不是指示。在另一个检查点的中途不会发生检查点。

original: 9.11.3. Usually, each sentence in the text of an ability forms a single instruction. After each instruction, an ability pauses its resolution to allow priority windows to open and other abilities to resolve. First, a checkpoint occurs, allowing any appropriate conditional abilities to be marked as pending in a reaction window, then targets are announced for the next instruction. Finally, the next instruction becomes imminent, allowing interrupts relevant to that instruction to resolve in an interrupt window.
translation: 一项能力中的大多数句子都各自对应一条单独的指示。每条指示之后，能力都会暂停其结算，以允许优先权窗口开启并让其他能力结算。首先会进行一次检查点，让适当的条件能力在一个响应窗口中被标记为待结算；然后为下一条指示宣告目标。最后，下一条指示变为即将发生，使与该指示相关的打断能在一个打断窗口中结算。

original: 9.11.4. Some sentences are not instructions, some sentences encompass multiple instructions, and some instructions encompass multiple sentences. These are the cases in which sentences do not correspond one-to-one with instructions:
translation: 有些句子不是指示，有些句子包含多条指示，也有些指示跨越多个句子。以下是句子与指示并非一一对应的情况：

original: 9.11.4.a. A sentence is not part of any instruction if it only provides clarification, restrictions or conditions on when or how the ability it appears in can be triggered, or otherwise does not give directions to the players or the game state that would be carried out as the ability resolves.
translation: 如果一个句子只提供说明、限制或关于其中所出现之能力何时或如何能够被触发的条件，或者除此之外并未向玩家或游戏状态发出将在能力结算时执行的指令，那么该句子就不属于任何指示的一部分。

original: A sentence reading "Use this ability only by spending credits from a {subtype:stealth} card." is not an instruction or part of any instruction. It is a restriction that applies to the entire ability.
translation: 一句写着“仅通过支付来自一张{subtype:隐匿}卡牌的信用点来使用此能力。”的句子，不是一条指示，也不是任何指示的一部分。它是适用于整个能力的一项限制。

original: 9.11.4.b. If a sentence directs a player to play, install, or access more than one card, each such card is handled as a separate instruction. The instruction ends and a new one begins immediately before each play, install, or access after the first.
translation: 如果一个句子指示玩家打出、安装或读取多于1张卡牌，则其中每张此类卡牌都作为一条单独的指示处理。在第一次之后的每一次打出、安装或读取之前，前一条指示结束，下一条指示立即开始。

original: The Corp plays {card:Shipment from MirrorMorph}, which has a single sentence directing them to install up to 3 cards from HQ. This is treated as though it said, "You may install a card from HQ. You may install a card from HQ. You may install a card from HQ.", or equivalently, "You may install a card from HQ. Repeat this process 2 more times."
translation: 公司打出{card:幻镜所的货物}，其只有一个句子指示其从总部安装至多3张卡牌。这应视为其写着：“你可以从总部安装1张卡牌。你可以从总部安装1张卡牌。你可以从总部安装1张卡牌。”或者等价地视为：“你可以从总部安装1张卡牌。重复此流程2次。”

original: 9.11.4.c. If a sentence directs a player to choose 1 or more targets, but does not act on that choice or describe any other effects, that sentence and the following sentence form a single instruction.
translation: 如果一个句子指示玩家选择1个或更多目标，但并不对该选择采取行动，也不描述其他效果，则该句子与后一句共同构成一条单独的指示。

original: {card:Tinkering}'s play ability reads, "Choose a piece of ice. That ice gains {subtype:sentry}, {subtype:code gate}, and {subtype:barrier} until the end of the turn." The first sentence does nothing except direct the Runner to select a target, so it forms a single instruction with the second sentence. The target is chosen as the instruction becomes imminent, and the card gains the subtypes when the instruction resolves.
translation: {card:校正}的打出能力写着：“选择一张防火墙。该防火墙获得{subtype:警报}、{subtype:门禁}与{subtype:屏障}，直到回合结束。”第一句除了指示潜袭者选择目标之外不做任何事，因此它与第二句共同构成一条单独的指示。目标会在该指示变为即将发生时被选定，而该卡牌会在该指示结算时获得这些子类别。

original: 9.11.4.d. Some older cards have search effects written in the same sentence as the effects that will be performed upon any found cards. Treat these sentences as if ending the search and performing any necessary shuffling is the end of an instruction. A checkpoint occurs while cards found by the search are in the set-aside zone, then the remainder of the sentence is treated as the next instruction.
translation: 某些较旧的卡牌将搜索效果，与对找到的卡牌将要执行之效果，写在同一个句子中。将这类句子视为：结束搜索并完成任何必要的洗牌，就是一条指示的结束。此时，在搜索找到的卡牌仍位于置于一旁区时，会发生一次检查点；然后句子的其余部分被视为下一条指示。

original: The Runner uses {card:Djinn} to search for a program while the Corp has {card:Personality Profiles} in their score area. The Runner finds and sets aside a copy of {card:Datasucker} and shuffles the stack. This ends an instruction, and since the search has occurred, {card:Personality Profiles}'s ability meets its trigger condition. The Corp resolves the ability during a reaction window before the next instruction becomes imminent, forcing the Runner to trash a random card from their grip. Finally, the second instruction resolves and the Runner adds the set-aside {card:Datasucker} to their grip.
translation: 潜袭者在公司计分区有{card:人格剖析}时，使用{card:巨灵}搜索一个程序。潜袭者找到一张{card:数据吸食虫}并将其置于一旁，然后洗切牌库。这结束了一条指示，而由于搜索已经发生，{card:人格剖析}的能力满足其触发条件。公司会在下一条指示变为即将发生之前，于一个响应窗口中结算该能力，迫使潜袭者随机销毁其手牌中的1张牌。最后，第二条指示结算，潜袭者将被置于一旁的{card:数据吸食虫}加入其手牌。

original: 9.11.4.e. Some older cards direct a player to look at or reveal a set of cards in the same sentence as the effects that will be performed upon those cards. Treat these sentences as if making the cards visible to the relevant player(s) is the end of an instruction. A checkpoint occurs once the cards are visible to the relevant player(s), then the remainder of the sentence is treated as the next instruction.
translation: 某些较旧的卡牌将查看或展示一组卡牌的效果，与对这些卡牌将要执行之效果，写在同一个句子中。将这类句子视为：使这些卡牌对相关玩家可见，就是一条指示的结束。一旦这些卡牌对相关玩家可见，便会发生一次检查点；然后句子的其余部分被视为下一条指示。

original: The Corp is resolving the first subroutine on {card:Architect}, which, in one sentence, allows the Corp to look at cards in R&D and install one of them. Looking at the top 5 cards of R&D ends the ability's first instruction. Once the Corp is able to see those cards, they can choose a target for the second instruction, which will install it. Since the install is optional, the Corp can also decline to choose a target, and the second instruction will have no effect. After the second instruction resolves, the ability is complete, and the Corp's permission to look at cards in R&D ends.
translation: 公司正在结算{card:建筑师}的第一个子程序，该子程序用一个句子同时允许公司查看研发中心中的卡牌并安装其中1张。查看研发中心顶端的5张牌，会结束该能力的第一条指示。一旦公司能够看见这些卡牌，其就可以为第二条指示选择一个目标，而第二条指示会安装该目标。由于安装是可选的，公司也可以选择不指定目标，此时第二条指示将没有效果。在第二条指示结算后，该能力完成，公司查看研发中心卡牌的许可也随之结束。

original: 9.11.4.f. If an ability contains a nested cost, the choice of whether or not to pay that cost ends an instruction. If the cost is paid (or not paid) such that the corresponding effect will be carried out, that part of the ability becomes the next instruction. See also {ref:rule_nested_cost}.
translation: 如果一项能力包含内部费用，则是否支付该费用的选择会结束一条指示。如果支付了该费用（或未支付该费用）并因此会执行相应效果，则该能力的该部分成为下一条指示。另见{ref:rule_nested_cost}。

original: 9.11.4.g. If an effect directs a player to choose between a set of options that would create different effects, that choice ends an instruction. Each option begins its own instruction or set of instructions, and the one chosen will resolve next.
translation: 如果一个效果指示玩家在一组选项之间作出选择，而这些选项会产生不同效果，则该选择会结束一条指示。每个选项都会开始其自身的一条或一组指示，而被选择的那个会在接下来结算。

original: The Runner encounters {card:Data Raven} and is forced by its first ability to resolve either "take 1 tag" or "end the run." Making this choice ends the first instruction, and the option the Runner chooses will become imminent after a checkpoint.
translation: 潜袭者遭遇{card:数据乌鸦}，并被其第一个能力迫使结算“获得1个锁定”或“终止本次潜袭”之一。作出这个选择会结束第一条指示，而潜袭者所选的那个选项会在一次检查点之后变为即将发生。

original: 9.11.5. If an ability initiates a timing structure, its source may have linked abilities that apply during that timing structure. These are frequently written directly after the instruction that creates the timing structure, but they are not instructions in the same ability.
translation: 如果一项能力发起了一个时序结构，则其来源可能还具有在该时序结构期间适用的关联能力。这些能力常常直接写在创造该时序结构的指示之后，但它们并不是同一项能力中的指示。

original: 9.12. Other Rules and Terminology
translation: 其他规则与术语

original: 9.12.1. Simultaneous Effects
translation: 同时发生的效果

original: 9.12.1.a. If more than one effect attempts to modify the same value, determine its final value from its default value by first applying any effect that sets it to a specific value, then applying each effect that increases the value, and finally applying each effect that lowers the value.
translation: 如果多于一个效果试图修改同一个数值，则从其默认值开始确定其最终数值：先适用任何将其设为特定数值的效果，再依次适用每个提高该数值的效果，最后依次适用每个降低该数值的效果。

original: 9.12.1.b. If more than one effect attempts to add or remove the same subtype from a card, count the number of times the subtype is added (including from the card's printed text) and the number of times the subtype is removed. As long as the number of times added is greater, the card has that subtype. As long as the number of times removed is greater or the numbers are equal, the card does not have that subtype.
translation: 如果多于一个效果试图为一张卡牌添加或移除同一个子类别，则计算该子类别被添加了多少次（包括来自该卡牌印刷文字的添加），以及被移除了多少次。只要添加次数更多，该卡牌就具有该子类别。只要移除次数更多，或两者次数相等，该卡牌就不具有该子类别。

original: 9.12.1.c. If more than one effect gives a player a choice of how to resolve an ability or game rule such that both players are instructed to make a choice that can only be made once, the active player makes that choice. The effects that granted the players the choice otherwise resolve as normal.
translation: 如果多于一个效果给予玩家选择如何结算某项能力或游戏规则的权利，且双方玩家都被指示作出一个只能作出一次的选择，则由主动玩家作出该选择。给予玩家选择权的那些效果在其他方面仍照常结算。

original: If {card:Chronos Protocol} and {card:Titanium Ribs} are both active, both players are instructed to choose the card trashed by the first net damage each turn. Since this is impossible, only the active player chooses that card. Since {card:Chronos Protocol} also instructs the Corp to look at the Runner's grip and this is not prevented or contradicted by any other ability, this part of the effect happens on either player's turn.
translation: 如果{card:柯罗诺斯协议}与{card:钛金肋骨}同时处于现行状态，则双方玩家都会被指示选择每回合第一次网络伤害所销毁的卡牌。由于这不可能同时做到，因此只有主动玩家来选择那张卡牌。由于{card:柯罗诺斯协议}还会指示公司查看潜袭者的手牌，而这一点并未被任何其他能力防止或矛盾，因此这部分效果会在任一玩家的回合中照常发生。

original: 9.12.1.d. If a static or lingering effect changes whether a second effect is active, what objects it applies to, or what it does to those objects, the second effect {term: depends on} the first effect. To determine the characteristics of each object in a game state where dependencies exist, use the following process: begin with each object's printed characteristics. Then, apply effects that modify objects to the game state in the order specified by {ref:rule_independent_effects}. Do not apply an effect if it originates from a static ability that is no longer present or no longer active due to a previously-applied effect. When all active effects are applied, this process is complete and each object has its correct characteristics.
translation: 如果一个持续效果或残留效果会改变第二个效果是否现行、它适用于哪些对象，或它对这些对象做什么，则第二个效果{term:依赖于}第一个效果。为了确定在存在依赖关系的游戏状态中每个对象的特征，使用以下流程：从每个对象的印刷特征开始。然后按{ref:rule_independent_effects}指定的顺序，将修改对象的效果适用于游戏状态。如果某个效果来自一项持续能力，而由于先前已适用的效果，该持续能力已不再存在或不再现行，则不要适用该效果。当所有现行效果都已被适用时，此流程完成，每个对象都具有其正确的特征。

original: 9.12.1.e. When applying effects as indicated by {ref:rule_dependent_effects}, an effect that is waiting to be applied is {term:independent} if it does not depend on any other effects waiting to be applied. Always choose an independent effect as the next effect to apply, if possible. If there are multiple independent effects at once, those effects can be applied in any order relative to each other. (The order chosen should have no impact on the ultimate result.) If there are no independent effects (because each remaining effect depends on another, forming a "loop"), check the source of each of those effects, and treat effects from hosted objects as if they did not depend on effects from the objects they are hosted on.
translation: 在依照{ref:rule_dependent_effects}适用效果时，如果一个等待被适用的效果不依赖于任何其他等待被适用的效果，则它就是{term:独立的}的。若可能，始终选择一个独立效果作为下一个要适用的效果。如果同时存在多个独立效果，则这些效果彼此之间可以按任意顺序适用。（所选顺序不应影响最终结果。）如果不存在独立效果（因为每个剩余效果都依赖另一个效果，形成“循环”），则检查这些效果各自的来源，并将来自附载对象的效果视为不依赖于它们所附载对象产生的效果。

original: {card:Mother Goddess}, {card:Ansel 1.0}, and {card:Warden Fatuma} are rezzed, and {card:Hush} is hosted on {card:Mother Goddess}. {card:Mother Goddess}, {card:Warden Fatuma}, and {card:Hush} all produce effects that could modify the characteristics of {card:Mother Goddess}, so in order to determine {card:Mother Goddess}'s true characteristics, we must examine how those effects depend on each other. {card:Mother Goddess}'s effect grants it the subtypes of {card:Ansel 1.0}, including the {subtype:bioroid} subtype, which affects whether {card:Warden Fatuma}'s ability applies to {card:Mother Goddess}, so {card:Warden Fatuma}'s effect depends on {card:Mother Goddess}'s effect. {card:Hush}'s effect removes {card:Mother Goddess}'s ability, so {card:Mother Goddess}'s effect depends on {card:Hush}'s effect. No other effects change how {card:Hush}'s effect behaves. Since {card:Hush}'s effect is independent, it must be applied first. When it is applied, {card:Mother Goddess}'s ability no longer exists, so {card:Warden Fatuma}'s effect is now independent. It is applied next and grants a subroutine to {card:Ansel 1.0}, but not to {card:Mother Goddess}, which does not have the {subtype:bioroid} subtype.
translation: {card:母神}、{card:安塞尔1.0}与{card:监察员法图玛}都已激活，而{card:消音}附载在{card:母神}上。{card:母神}、{card:监察员法图玛}与{card:消音}都会产生可能修改{card:母神}特征的效果，因此为了确定{card:母神}的真实特征，我们必须检视这些效果如何彼此依赖。{card:母神}的效果会赋予其{card:安塞尔1.0}的子类别，其中包括{subtype:生化人}，这会影响{card:监察员法图玛}的能力是否适用于{card:母神}，因此{card:监察员法图玛}的效果依赖于{card:母神}的效果。{card:消音}的效果会移除{card:母神}的能力，因此{card:母神}的效果依赖于{card:消音}的效果。没有其他效果会改变{card:消音}效果的运作方式。由于{card:消音}的效果是独立的，因此必须先适用它。适用之后，{card:母神}的能力不再存在，因此{card:监察员法图玛}的效果现在成为独立效果。接着适用它，它会为{card:安塞尔1.0}赋予一个子程序，但不会赋予{card:母神}，因为后者并不具有{subtype:生化人}子类别。

original: {card:Hush} is hosted on {card:Magnet}. {card:Hush}'s ability creates an effect that removes abilities from {card:Magnet}, and {card:Magnet}'s ability creates an effect that removes an ability from {card:Hush}. The dependencies of these effects form a loop, so the hosting relationship of their source objects is considered, and the effect from {card:Hush}'s ability ignores its dependence on the effect from {card:Magnet}'s ability. {card:Hush}'s effect is therefore treated as independent and applied first. {card:Magnet}'s ability and the resulting effect no longer exist, so they are never applied.
translation: {card:消音}附载在{card:磁铁}上。{card:消音}的能力创造一个会移除{card:磁铁}能力的效果，而{card:磁铁}的能力创造一个会移除{card:消音}某项能力的效果。这些效果的依赖关系形成一个循环，因此需要考虑其来源对象之间的附载关系，而来自{card:消音}能力的效果会被视为忽略其对{card:磁铁}能力效果的依赖。因此，{card:消音}的效果被视为独立并先适用。{card:磁铁}的能力及其产生的效果都不再存在，因此永远不会被适用。

original: 9.12.2. Quantities and Sets
translation: 数量与集合

original: 9.12.2.a. If an effect acts on a set of cards for a single purpose, then the effect acts on all of those cards together simultaneously rather than one at a time.
translation: 如果一个效果为了单一目的作用于一组卡牌，则该效果会同时整体作用于这些卡牌，而不是逐张依次作用。

original: The Runner uses {card:Singularity} to simultaneously trash a rezzed {card:Warroid Tracker} and a rezzed {card:Hostile Infrastructure}. {card:Hostile Infrastructure} has a trigger condition of "Whenever the Runner trashes a Corp card", so it sees both trashed cards and becomes pending twice. By contrast, {card:Warroid Tracker} has a trigger condition of "Whenever the Runner trashes at least 1 card…", so it sees only a single event that trashed multiple cards. {card:Warroid Tracker}'s ability becomes pending only once.
translation: 潜袭者使用{card:奇点}，同时销毁一张已激活的{card:生化战士追迹者}与一张已激活的{card:敌意架构}。{card:敌意架构}的触发条件是“Whenever the Runner trashes a Corp card”，因此它会看到两张被销毁的卡牌，并两次变为待结算。相比之下，{card:生化战士追迹者}的触发条件是“Whenever the Runner trashes at least 1 card…”，因此它只会看到一个销毁了多张卡牌的单一事件。{card:生化战士追迹者}的能力只会变为待结算1次。

original: 9.12.2.b. {n}Some abilities perform effects based on a calculated quantity, usually indicated by a phrase like "for each", "for every", or "plus". If all of the effects tied to a quantity in this way are listed in {ref:rule_aggregated_instructions}, then the effects are performed only once, with the values included in the effect aggregated according to the calculated quantity. If a value aggregated in this way is less than or equal to 0, instead the part of the effect associated with that value does not take place at all. If an ability indicates that effects should be performed a number of times or across a number of targets and any part of those effects is not listed in {ref:rule_aggregated_instructions}, then the effects are not aggregated.{/n}
translation: {n}某些能力会依据一个经过计算的数量来执行效果，通常以诸如“for each”、“for every”或“plus”之类的短语表示。如果以这种方式与某个数量关联的全部效果都列在{ref:rule_aggregated_instructions}中，则这些效果只执行一次，并且效果中包含的数值会按照该计算数量进行汇总。如果以这种方式汇总的某个数值小于或等于0，则与该数值相关的那部分效果完全不会发生。若一项能力表明某些效果应执行若干次，或应跨若干个目标执行，而这些效果中任何一部分未列在{ref:rule_aggregated_instructions}中，则这些效果不进行汇总。{/n}

original: The Runner plays {card:Ritual} while they have 3 [click] remaining and an installed copy of {card:The Class Act}. {card:Ritual}'s instruction will have the Runner perform 1 instance of drawing 3 cards, so {card:The Class Act}'s interrupt ability will first have the Runner look at the top 4 cards of their stack and add 1 to the bottom.
translation: 潜袭者打出{card:仪式}时，其尚有3个[click]，且已安装一张{card:一流选手}。{card:仪式}的指示会让潜袭者执行1次抽3张牌，因此{card:一流选手}的打断能力会先让潜袭者查看其牌库顶端的4张牌，并将其中1张置于底部。

original: The Runner accesses {card:Urtica Cipher} with 3 hosted advancement counters. The Corp resolves the instruction "do 2 net damage plus 1 net damage for each hosted advancement counter", doing a single instance of 5 net damage. They can only apply the interrupt ability from {card:Prāna Condenser} to the damage once.
translation: 潜袭者读取附载有3个推进指示物的{card:荨麻暗码}。公司结算其指示“造成2点网络伤害，再加上每个附载的推进指示物额外造成1点网络伤害”，从而一次性造成5点网络伤害。其只能将{card:真气冷凝器}的打断能力对这次伤害适用1次。

original: The Corp has a rezzed copy of {card:NASX} and plays {card:realloc()}. Its ability has the Corp gain credits based on a "for each", but it also has the Corp derez cards based on the same "for each". Since derezzing cards is not an aggregated effect, none of the effects are aggregated, and the Corp will be able to resolve 2 separate instances of the second ability on {card:NASX}.

The following effects are aggregated when performed in a single instruction, as described in {ref:rule_calculated_quantity}: gaining, losing, or spending a number of credits; gaining, losing, or spending a number of clicks; taking, removing, or preventing a number of tags; taking, removing, or preventing a number of bad publicity; looking at or revealing a number of cards from a specified location; drawing a number of cards; trashing a number of cards from specified locations (including by damage); and shuffling a number of cards from a player's discard pile into their deck.
