必须

original: 9.12.3.a. If a card ability states that a player "must" do something without stipulating how that player must do so, then that player is forced to make any decisions necessary to satisfy the requirement, even if it requires the use of other card abilities.
translation: 如果一项卡牌能力表明某位玩家“must”做某事，但未规定该玩家必须如何做到，那么该玩家就被迫作出为满足该要求所需的任何决定，即使这需要使用其他卡牌能力。

original: The Runner has an {card:Imp} and a {card:Scrubber} installed and accesses {card:Mumbad Virtual Tour}. If the Runner only has 4[c], they must still choose to either spend a counter from {card:Imp} to trash {card:Mumbad Virtual Tour} if they are able to do so or spend recurring credits on {card:Scrubber} to help pay the trash cost of the {card:Mumbad Virtual Tour}.
translation: 潜袭者已安装{card:小恶魔}与{card:清洗者}，并读取{card:孟巴德虚拟之旅}。如果潜袭者只有4[c]，其仍必须选择：若其能够如此做，则从{card:小恶魔}上花费1个病毒指示物来销毁{card:孟巴德虚拟之旅}；或者花费{card:清洗者}上的经常性信用点来帮助支付{card:孟巴德虚拟之旅}的销毁费用。

original: 9.12.3.b. If a card ability states that a player "must" do something and specifies the means by which that player must do so, then that player is not required to carry out the effect except by the means specified, even if it would be possible through the use of other card abilities.
translation: 如果一项卡牌能力表明某位玩家“must”做某事，并明确规定该玩家必须通过何种方式做到，那么除非通过所指定的方式，否则该玩家不需要执行该效果，即使通过使用其他卡牌能力本来也有可能做到。

original: The Runner has {card:Imp} and {card:Neutralize All Threats} installed when they access a card with a trash cost greater than the number of credits they have available to spend. Because they are unable to trash the card by paying its trash cost, they are not required to spend a counter from {card:Imp} in order to trash it.
translation: 潜袭者已安装{card:小恶魔}与{card:消除威胁}，并读取一张销毁费用大于其可用信用点数量的卡牌。由于其无法通过支付该卡牌的销毁费用来销毁它，因此其不必为了销毁它而花费{card:小恶魔}上的1个病毒指示物。

original: 9.12.3.c. If the "must" ability presents a player with a choice between two or more effects, that player must choose an effect that can be fully resolved. If none of the choices can be fully resolved, then the "must" ability does nothing.
translation: 如果这项“must”能力向玩家提供在两个或更多效果之间进行选择，则该玩家必须选择一个能够被完整结算的效果。如果没有任何选项能够被完整结算，则该“must”能力不做任何事。

original: If the first subroutine on {card:Fairchild 2.0} resolves while the Runner has no installed cards but 3[c], then the Runner must choose to pay 2[c]. When the second subroutine on {card:Fairchild 2.0} resolves, the Runner can neither pay 2[c] nor trash an installed card, so nothing happens.
translation: 如果{card:仙童2.0}的第一个子程序结算时，潜袭者没有已安装的卡牌但有3[c]，则其必须选择支付2[c]。当{card:仙童2.0}的第二个子程序结算时，潜袭者既不能支付2[c]，也不能销毁一张已安装的卡牌，因此不会发生任何事。

original: 9.12.3.d. Making a choice between effects is always a separate instruction from resolving the chosen effect (see {ref:rule_choice_instruction}). The previous rule only requires the player to choose an effect that is possible to resolve; it does not require the chosen effect to actually resolve as expected. Once an effect has been chosen, the player can apply interrupts to modify, prevent, or replace that effect as normal.
translation: 在效果之间作出选择，始终与结算被选择的效果分属不同的指示（见{ref:rule_choice_instruction}）。前述规则只要求玩家选择一个可能被结算的效果；它不要求被选中的效果一定按预期实际结算。一旦选择了某个效果，玩家仍可像平常一样适用打断来修改、防止或替代该效果。

original: If the Runner encounters {card:Data Raven}, they must choose to either take a tag or end the run. The Runner can choose to take the tag, then avoid the tag with {card:Decoy}. This does not cause the run to end, as the decision to take the tag has already been made.
translation: 如果潜袭者遭遇{card:数据乌鸦}，其必须选择获得1个锁定或终止本次潜袭。潜袭者可以选择获得该锁定，然后再用{card:虚假目标}避免该锁定。这不会导致潜袭结束，因为作出获得锁定这一决定的时点已经过去。

original: 9.12.3.e. A singular "must" ability cannot force a player to pay an additional cost they wish to decline, but a player cannot avoid choosing a fully resolvable effect from among multiple options in a "must" ability by declining to pay the additional cost for one of those choices.
translation: 单数形式的“must”能力不能强迫玩家支付其不愿支付的额外费用；但在一项“must”能力的多个选项中，玩家也不能通过拒绝为其中某个选项支付额外费用，来回避选择一个可以被完整结算的效果。

original: If {card:Service Outage} is active and the Runner has {card:Always Be Running} installed, the Runner can decline to pay the additional 1[c] to make a run with their first [click], thus satisfying the "must" of {card:Always Be Running} and allowing them to spend their first click on a different action. However, if a Runner has a {card:False Echo} installed and passes an unrezzed Archer, the Corporation cannot choose to rez the Archer but decline to forfeit an agenda; the Corp must either pay 4[c] and forfeit an agenda to rez the Archer or add the Archer to HQ.
translation: 如果{card:服务停运}处于现行状态，而潜袭者已安装{card:始终运行}，则潜袭者可以拒绝支付额外的1[c]，来用其第一个[click]发起潜袭，从而满足{card:始终运行}的“must”要求，并得以将其第一个点击用于其他行动。然而，如果潜袭者已安装{card:虚假回声}，并通过了一张未激活的{card:射手}，则公司不能选择激活{card:射手}却拒绝废除一张议案；公司必须要么支付4[c]并废除一张议案来激活{card:射手}，要么将{card:射手}加入总部。

original: 9.12.4. Repeat this process
translation: 重复此流程

original: 9.12.4.a. If an ability instructs a player to "repeat this process" without specifying how many times to do so, then that player resolves the ability again, including the instruction to "repeat this process" if it is still applicable.
translation: 如果一项能力指示玩家“repeat this process”而未说明应重复多少次，则该玩家再次结算该能力，包括其中“repeat this process”的指示，只要它仍然适用。

original: 9.12.4.b. If an ability instructs a player to "repeat this process" a specified number of times, then that player resolves the entire ability, except for the repetition instruction, that many times in a row. The number of repetitions is determined after the first full resolution but before the first repetition, and once the number of repetitions is determined it cannot be changed.
translation: 如果一项能力指示玩家将“repeat this process”重复一个指定次数，则该玩家会将整个能力（重复指示本身除外）连续结算该指定次数。重复次数是在第一次完整结算之后、第一次重复开始之前确定的；一旦确定，便不能更改。

original: 9.12.4.c. Regardless of the number of times an ability is repeated, a checkpoint occurs after each full resolution of the ability's instructions, before another repetition begins.
translation: 无论一项能力被重复多少次，在其指示每完整结算一次之后、下一次重复开始之前，都会进行一次检查点。

original: 9.12.4.d. Each repetition of the ability is resolved independently of the others. If the ability provides the player with any choices, they may choose differently each time.
translation: 该能力的每次重复都彼此独立地结算。如果该能力给予玩家任何选择，其每次都可以作出不同选择。

original: 9.12.5. Persistent
translation: 持久

original: 9.12.5.a. A {term:persistent} ability is an ability on a Corp card marked with the "persistent" ability flag before its other text. When the Runner trashes a rezzed card they are accessing, its persistent abilities {term:persist} through a lingering effect that is created as the source card is trashed. See also {ref:sec_lingering_effects}.
translation: 一项{term:持久}能力，是指公司卡牌上在其他文字前带有“persistent”能力标记的能力。当潜袭者销毁其正在读取的一张已激活卡牌时，其持久能力会通过一个在来源卡牌被销毁时创建的残留效果而{term:继续生效}。另见{ref:sec_lingering_effects}。

original: 9.12.5.b. A persistent ability begins to persist simultaneously with the trashing of its source card. The ability never becomes inactive, nor is it considered a new ability.
translation: 一项持久能力会与其来源卡牌被销毁同时开始继续生效。该能力从不会变为非现行状态，也不会被视为一项新的能力。

original: 9.12.5.c. An ability only persists until just after the end of the run during which it began to persist. When the reaction window immediately following {ref:step_run_complete} of that run closes, the lingering effect allowing the ability to persist expires, and the ability ceases to persist.
translation: 一项能力只会继续生效到其开始继续生效的那次潜袭结束后紧接着的时点。当该次潜袭中紧随{ref:step_run_complete}之后的响应窗口关闭时，使该能力继续生效的残留效果失效，而该能力也随之不再继续生效。

original: 9.12.5.d. A persisting ability is only applicable to the run during which it began to persist. After the checkpoint following {ref:step_run_complete} of the run, no more instances of the ability can be created. Even if another run initiates during the reaction window following that checkpoint, new instances of any abilities persisting from the first run cannot become pending during the second run, even if their trigger conditions would normally be met during that second run.
translation: 继续生效的能力只适用于其开始继续生效的那次潜袭。在该次潜袭的{ref:step_run_complete}之后的检查点结束后，该能力不再能创建新的实例。即使在该检查点之后的响应窗口中又发起了另一次潜袭，任何从第一次潜袭继续生效的能力，其新实例也不能在第二次潜袭中变为待结算，即使其触发条件在第二次潜袭中本来会被满足。

original: The Runner trashes {card:AMAZE Amusements}, causing its "Whenever a run on this server ends" ability to persist. When the run ends, the Runner uses {card:Doppelgänger} to make another run while the persisting ability is still pending. The ability remains active so that its existing pending instance can resolve, but another instance cannot be created even if the Runner steals an agenda during the second run.
translation: 潜袭者销毁{card:惊奇迷乐园}，使其“Whenever a run on this server ends”能力继续生效。当该次潜袭结束时，潜袭者使用{card:双重幻影}在该继续生效的能力仍处于待结算状态时再次发起潜袭。该能力仍保持现行，以使其已经待结算的那个实例能够结算，但即使潜袭者在第二次潜袭中窃取了一张议案，也不能再创建另一个实例。

original: 9.12.6. Modal Abilities
translation: 模式能力

original: 9.12.6.a. Some abilities contain text organized into bulleted lists. These are called {term:modal abilities}, and each list item is called a {term:mode}.
translation: 某些能力包含以项目符号列表组织的文字。这些能力称为{term:模式能力}，而列表中的每一项称为一个{term:模式}。

original: 9.12.6.b. Each modal ability contains an instruction directing its controller to resolve 1 or more of its modes. The effect of this instruction is for the relevant player to choose the next mode to resolve. The first instruction of the chosen mode will be the next instruction to become imminent. The player does not need to choose modes in the order they are written. If the description of the number of modes to resolve contains "up to", the player may also choose not to resolve any more modes.
translation: 每项模式能力都包含一条指示，指示其操控者结算其中1个或更多模式。该指示的效果是让相关玩家选择接下来要结算的模式。所选模式的第一条指示将成为下一条即将发生的指示。玩家不需要按书写顺序选择模式。如果要结算的模式数量描述中包含“up to”，玩家也可以选择不再结算更多模式。

original: 9.12.6.c. After the instructions of a mode are complete, the game returns to the instruction to resolve 1 or more modes. If the maximum allowed number of modes have not yet been resolved, the player will choose another mode to resolve, as if resolving that initial instruction again. If the maximum number of allowed modes have been resolved, the game proceeds to the next instruction or ability following the list of modes.
translation: 当一个模式的各条指示结算完成后，游戏会返回到结算1个或更多模式的那条指示。如果尚未达到允许结算的最大模式数量，玩家将再选择一个模式来结算，就如同再次结算那条初始指示一样。如果已达到允许结算的最大模式数量，则游戏继续到该列表之后的下一条指示或能力。

original: 9.12.6.d. In a single instance of resolving a modal ability, each mode can be resolved no more than 1 time, unless the ability specifically states that its modes can be chosen more than once.
translation: 在一次模式能力的单个结算实例中，每个模式最多只能结算1次，除非该能力明确说明其模式可以被选择多次。
